```html cursor-zoom-follow.html theme={null}
      <script>
        (function () {
          "use strict";

          var html = document.documentElement;
          var root = document.getElementById("root");
          var cam = document.getElementById("zf-cam");
          var cursor = document.getElementById("zf-cursor");
          var ripple = document.getElementById("zf-ripple");
          var range = document.getElementById("zf-range");
          var tip = document.getElementById("zf-tip");
          var exportBtn = document.getElementById("zf-export");
          var exportStates = exportBtn.children;
          var rangeLabel = document.getElementById("zf-range-label");
          var menu = document.getElementById("zf-menu");
          var rows = menu.children;
          var line = document.getElementById("zf-line");

          var DEFAULTS = {};
          try {
            JSON.parse(html.getAttribute("data-composition-variables") || "[]").forEach(
              function (variable) {
                DEFAULTS[variable.id] = variable.default;
              },
            );
          } catch (error) {
            /* malformed declaration falls back to the inline defaults below */
          }
          var scopedVariables = {};
          try {
            if (window.__hyperframes && typeof window.__hyperframes.getVariables === "function") {
              scopedVariables = window.__hyperframes.getVariables() || {};
            }
          } catch (error) {
            /* no scoped variables API in this context */
          }
          var runtimeVars = Object.assign({}, window.__hfVariables || {}, scopedVariables);
          var vars = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, runtimeVars);

          function num(value, fallback, lo, hi) {
            var n = Number(value);
            if (!isFinite(n)) n = fallback;
            return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));
          }

          // Rebuilt from parsed digits, never the original string: a regex match
          // alone still carries the source text through, digit-by-digit reassembly
          // does not.
          function color(value, fallback) {
            var m = /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/.exec(String(value == null ? "" : value));
            if (!m) return fallback;
            var hex = m[1].length === 3 ? m[1].replace(/(.)/g, "$1$1") : m[1];
            var r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
            var g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
            var b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
            return "rgb(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ")";
          }

          // Hardcoded: the compositor rewrites the wrapper's attributes on mount.
          var compositionId = "cursor-zoom-follow";
          var duration = Math.max(
            0.001,
            parseFloat(
              root.dataset.duration || html.getAttribute("data-composition-duration") || "5.8",
            ),
          );
          var W = root.clientWidth || 1920;
          var H = root.clientHeight || 1080;
          var ZOOM = num(vars.zoom, 1.8, 1, 3);
          var accent = color(vars.accent, "rgb(10,132,255)");
          var u = W / 1920;
          // Mirrors @hyperframes/parsers' isSafeMediaUrl allowlist: this
          // composition has no build step to import it from, so the same
          // scheme rule (relative or http/https/blob/data:image only) is
          // inlined rather than trusting the raw variable into img.src.
          function safeImageUrl(value) {
            var s = typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
            if (s === "") return "";
            var stripped = s.replace(/[\u0000-\u0020]/g, "");
            var scheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):/i.exec(stripped);
            if (!scheme) return s;
            var proto = scheme[1].toLowerCase();
            if (proto === "https" || proto === "http" || proto === "blob") return s;
            if (proto === "data") return /^data:image\//i.test(s) ? s : "";
            return "";
          }
          // Runtime variables only: the declared default is empty (the built-in
          // dashboard), and page markup never becomes an image URL.
          var image = safeImageUrl(runtimeVars.image);
          var builtIn = image === "";
          if (!builtIn) {
            var img = document.getElementById("zf-img");
            img.src = image;
            img.style.display = "block";
            document.getElementById("zf-app").style.display = "none";
          }
          root.style.setProperty("--zf-accent", accent);
          ripple.style.borderWidth = 2 * u + "px";
          var ARROW = 64 * u;
          cursor.style.width = cursor.style.height = ARROW + "px";
          cursor.style.left = (-5 / 24) * ARROW + "px";
          cursor.style.top = (-3 / 24) * ARROW + "px";
          cursor.style.transformOrigin = (5 / 24) * ARROW + "px " + (3 / 24) * ARROW + "px";

          function pt(x, y) {
            return { x: (x / 100) * W, y: (y / 100) * H };
          }
          var CLICKS = [
            pt(num(vars.click1_x, 68.5, 0, 100), num(vars.click1_y, 7.5, 0, 100)),
            pt(num(vars.click2_x, 50, 0, 100), num(vars.click2_y, 48.5, 0, 100)),
            pt(num(vars.click3_x, 90.5, 0, 100), num(vars.click3_y, 7.5, 0, 100)),
          ];
          var START = pt(80, 88);
          var END = pt(104, 72);

          // Layout-space offsets inside the app, which ignore any transform a host puts on the player.
          function rowPoint(row) {
            return {
              x: menu.offsetLeft + row.offsetLeft + row.offsetWidth * 0.35,
              y: menu.offsetTop + row.offsetTop + row.offsetHeight * 0.5,
            };
          }

          var k = duration / 5.8;
          var T_C1 = 0.95 * k;
          var T_PICK = 1.45 * k;
          var T_C2 = 2.55 * k;
          var T_C3 = 3.65 * k;
          var EXIT_AT = 4.8 * k;
          var EXIT_END = 5.6 * k;
          function move(from, to, click, travel, dwell) {
            return {
              from: from,
              to: to,
              at: click - (travel + dwell) * k,
              end: click - dwell * k,
              click: click,
            };
          }
          // With a user image there is no menu, so the pick beat is skipped and the click ring carries it.
          var MOVES = [move(START, CLICKS[0], T_C1, 0.5, 0.2)];
          if (builtIn) MOVES.push(move(CLICKS[0], rowPoint(rows[2]), T_PICK, 0.25, 0.15));
          MOVES.push(move(MOVES[MOVES.length - 1].to, CLICKS[1], T_C2, 0.5, 0.2));
          MOVES.push(move(CLICKS[1], CLICKS[2], T_C3, 0.5, 0.2));

          function clamp01(u) {
            return u < 0 ? 0 : u > 1 ? 1 : u;
          }
          function mix(a, b, u) {
            return a + (b - a) * u;
          }
          var arriveEase = gsap.parseEase("power3.out");
          var easeInOut = gsap.parseEase("power2.inOut");
          var easeOut = gsap.parseEase("power2.out");
          var easeIn = gsap.parseEase("power2.in");
          var camEase = gsap.parseEase("power3.inOut");

          function arc(p0, p1, u, bend) {
            var cx = (p0.x + p1.x) / 2 - (p1.y - p0.y) * bend;
            var cy = (p0.y + p1.y) / 2 + (p1.x - p0.x) * bend;
            var w = 1 - u;
            return {
              x: w * w * p0.x + 2 * w * u * cx + u * u * p1.x,
              y: w * w * p0.y + 2 * w * u * cy + u * u * p1.y,
            };
          }

          function cursorAt(t) {
            var here = START;
            for (var i = 0; i < MOVES.length; i++) {
              var m = MOVES[i];
              if (t < m.at) return here;
              if (t <= m.end)
                return arc(m.from, m.to, arriveEase(clamp01((t - m.at) / (m.end - m.at))), 0.12);
              here = m.to;
            }
            if (t < EXIT_AT) return here;
            return arc(here, END, easeIn(clamp01((t - EXIT_AT) / (EXIT_END - EXIT_AT))), -0.1);
          }

          function zoomAt(t) {
            if (t < EXIT_AT) return mix(1, ZOOM, camEase(clamp01((t - 0.1 * k) / (0.85 * k))));
            return mix(ZOOM, 1, camEase(clamp01((t - EXIT_AT) / (1.0 * k))));
          }

          // The camera aims between the cursor and the click it is heading for, so the push leads.
          function aimAt(t) {
            var c = cursorAt(t);
            var next = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < MOVES.length; i++) {
              if (t <= MOVES[i].click) {
                next = MOVES[i].to;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (!next) return c;
            return { x: mix(c.x, next.x, 0.6), y: mix(c.y, next.y, 0.6) };
          }

          // A critically damped spring over the aim, integrated once at load and read back by time.
          var FPS = 60;
          var OMEGA = 6;
          var samples = [];
          var s = aimAt(0);
          var v = { x: 0, y: 0 };
          var SUB = 4;
          var dt = 1 / (FPS * SUB);
          var frames = Math.ceil(duration * FPS) + 1;
          for (var f = 0; f <= frames; f++) {
            samples.push({ x: s.x, y: s.y });
            for (var j = 0; j < SUB; j++) {
              var aim = aimAt((f * SUB + j) * dt);
              v.x += (OMEGA * OMEGA * (aim.x - s.x) - 2 * OMEGA * v.x) * dt;
              v.y += (OMEGA * OMEGA * (aim.y - s.y) - 2 * OMEGA * v.y) * dt;
              s.x += v.x * dt;
              s.y += v.y * dt;
            }
          }
          function cameraAt(t) {
            var p = Math.max(0, Math.min(frames, t * FPS));
            var i = Math.floor(p);
            var a = samples[i];
            var b = samples[Math.min(frames, i + 1)];
            return { x: mix(a.x, b.x, p - i), y: mix(a.y, b.y, p - i) };
          }

          function lastClickBefore(t) {
            var hit = null;
            MOVES.forEach(function (m) {
              if (t >= m.click) hit = { at: m.click, p: m.to };
            });
            return hit;
          }

          // 0..1: down over 80 ms, back up over 200 ms.
          function pressAt(since) {
            if (since < 0 || since >= 0.28) return 0;
            return since < 0.08 ? since / 0.08 : 1 - easeOut((since - 0.08) / 0.2);
          }
          // Elements at rest carry no transform: one left over from a transition drew different
          // pixels for the same t after a seek.
          function moving(u, css) {
            return u > 0 && u < 1 ? css : "";
          }
          function buttonPress(since) {
            var press = pressAt(since);
            return press ? "scale(" + (1 - 0.04 * press).toFixed(3) + ")" : "";
          }

          var LINE_30 = [40, 36, 38, 30, 31, 22, 25, 17, 19, 10, 12];
          var LINE_90 = [46, 44, 45, 40, 41, 35, 24, 19, 21, 15, 12];

          function render(t) {
            var z = zoomAt(t);
            var c = cameraAt(t);
            // Keep the zoomed window inside the screen so its edge never shows.
            var hw = W / (2 * z);
            var hh = H / (2 * z);
            var cx = Math.max(hw, Math.min(W - hw, c.x));
            var cy = Math.max(hh, Math.min(H - hh, c.y));
            cam.style.transform =
              "translate(" +
              (W / 2 - cx * z).toFixed(2) +
              "px," +
              (H / 2 - cy * z).toFixed(2) +
              "px) scale(" +
              z.toFixed(4) +
              ")";

            var p = cursorAt(t);
            var hit = lastClickBefore(t);
            var since = hit ? t - hit.at : 99;
            cursor.style.transform =
              "translate(" +
              p.x.toFixed(2) +
              "px," +
              p.y.toFixed(2) +
              "px) scale(" +
              (1 - 0.15 * pressAt(since)).toFixed(3) +
              ")";
            cursor.style.opacity = t >= duration ? "0" : "1";

            var ring = since / 0.35;
            ripple.style.opacity = ring < 1 ? (1 - ring).toFixed(3) : "0";
            if (ring < 1) {
              var r = (12 + 32 * easeOut(ring)) * u;
              ripple.style.width = ripple.style.height = (2 * r).toFixed(2) + "px";
              ripple.style.transform =
                "translate(" + (hit.p.x - r).toFixed(2) + "px," + (hit.p.y - r).toFixed(2) + "px)";
            }

            if (!builtIn) return;

            var picked = t >= T_PICK;
            var shown =
              easeOut(clamp01((t - T_C1) / 0.18)) * (1 - clamp01((t - T_PICK - 0.05) / 0.12));
            menu.style.opacity = shown.toFixed(3);
            menu.style.transform = moving(
              shown,
              "translateY(" +
                (-4 * u * (1 - shown)).toFixed(2) +
                "px) scale(" +
                (0.97 + 0.03 * shown).toFixed(4) +
                ")",
            );
            range.classList.toggle("open", shown > 0);
            range.style.transform = buttonPress(t - T_C1);
            rangeLabel.textContent = picked ? "Last 90 days" : "Last 30 days";
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
              var row = rows[i];
              var x = p.x - menu.offsetLeft - row.offsetLeft;
              var y = p.y - menu.offsetTop - row.offsetTop;
              var over = x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < row.offsetWidth && y < row.offsetHeight;
              row.classList.toggle("hover", shown > 0 && over);
              row.lastElementChild.style.opacity = i === (picked ? 2 : 1) ? "1" : "0";
            }

            var redraw = easeInOut(clamp01((t - T_PICK - 0.05) / 0.4));
            line.setAttribute(
              "d",
              LINE_30.map(function (y30, i) {
                return (i ? "L" : "M") + i * 10 + " " + mix(y30, LINE_90[i], redraw).toFixed(2);
              }).join(" "),
            );

            var tipOn = clamp01((t - T_C2) / 0.25);
            tip.style.opacity = tipOn.toFixed(3);
            tip.style.transform = moving(
              tipOn,
              "translateY(" + ((1 - tipOn) * 8).toFixed(2) + "px)",
            );

            // Export, then Exporting…, then a check held until the camera pulls out.
            var busy = clamp01((t - T_C3 - 0.05) / 0.15);
            var done = clamp01((t - T_C3 - 0.55 * k) / 0.15);
            var reset = clamp01((t - EXIT_AT) / 0.15);
            exportStates[0].style.opacity = Math.max(1 - busy, reset).toFixed(3);
            exportStates[1].style.opacity = (busy * (1 - done)).toFixed(3);
            exportStates[2].style.opacity = (done * (1 - reset)).toFixed(3);
            exportStates[2].firstElementChild.style.transform = moving(
              done,
              "scale(" + (0.5 + 0.5 * easeOut(done)).toFixed(3) + ")",
            );
            exportBtn.style.transform = buttonPress(t - T_C3);
          }

          var clock = { t: 0 };
          var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
          tl.to(
            clock,
            {
              t: duration,
              duration: duration,
              ease: "none",
              onUpdate: function () {
                render(clock.t);
              },
            },
            0,
          );
          render(0);
          tl.seek(0);
          window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
          window.__timelines[compositionId] = tl;
        })();
      </script>
    </template>
  </body>
</html>
```

Copy npx hyperframes add cursor-zoom-follow to the clipboard

That writes one file: `compositions/components/cursor-zoom-follow.html`.

## Paste it into your composition

Open `compositions/components/cursor-zoom-follow.html` and copy what is inside into your own composition.

A component has no size or duration of its own. It takes both from the composition
you paste it into.

## Variables

Every one of these has a default, so the piece works untouched. Set the ones you
want to change on the element:

| Variable | Default | Accepts | What it does |
| - | - | - | - |
| `image` | \`\` | image | Your own screen capture. Leave empty for the built-in dashboard. |
| `zoom` | `1.8` | 1.2 to 2.6, step 0.1 | |
| `click1_x` | `68.5` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `click1_y` | `7.5` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `click2_x` | `50` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `click2_y` | `48.5` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `click3_x` | `90.5` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `click3_y` | `7.5` | 0% to 100%, step 0.5% | |
| `accent` | `#0a84ff` | color | |

Set them with `data-variable-values` on the element that mounts it. These are the
defaults, so this behaves exactly like the preview above until you change one:

```html wrap theme={null}
<div
  data-composition-id="cursor-zoom-follow"
  data-composition-src="compositions/components/cursor-zoom-follow.html"
  data-variable-values='{"image":"","zoom":1.8,"click1_x":68.5,"click1_y":7.5,"click2_x":50,"click2_y":48.5,"click3_x":90.5,"click3_y":7.5,"accent":"#0a84ff"}'
></div>
```

# Curtain Reveal
Source: https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog/components/curtain-reveal

Two pleated stage curtains gather outward from center, the way real velvet bunches at the tieback, revealing the stage underneath. A static pelmet frames the top; a soft spotlight can bloom in as they part.

# Curtain Reveal

Two pleated stage curtains gather outward from center, the way real velvet bunches at the tieback, revealing the stage underneath. A static pelmet frames the top; a soft spotlight can bloom in as they part.

**Curtain Reveal**

```html curtain-reveal.html theme={null}
<!doctype html>
<!--
  curtain-reveal: HyperFrames video primitive (transitions / stage reveal).

  Two velvet stage curtains meet at center, covering the frame. On cue they
  gather outward: each fold narrows, hardest at the outer edge, and the hem
  sweeps up slightly as the fabric bunches at the sides, revealing the stage
  underneath. An optional pelmet frames the top edge and never moves; an
  optional warm spotlight comes up as the curtains part.

  The stage is a SLOT. Callers supply it by placing an inert template
  anywhere in the HOST page (templates never render, and the runtime wipes
  the host clip's own children on mount, so the slot lives at document level):

    <template data-slot="curtain-reveal-stage"> ... </template>

  Slot content may be an <img>, a muted <video>, or arbitrary HTML; direct
  img/video children are stretched to cover the stage (packages/producer
  drives a slotted <video>'s own data-start/data-duration exactly like any
  other clip -- this primitive never reads or sets currentTime itself). With
  no slot, the stage renders a token spotlight card so the reveal reads on
  its own.

  Variables (declared in data-composition-variables below):
    - tone ("red" | "burgundy" | "navy" | "forest", default "burgundy"): curtain
      color.
    - pelmet ("on" | "off", default "on"): static valance framing the top.
    - spotlight ("on" | "off", default "on"): soft glow blooming over the
      stage as the curtains part.

  Envelope, fixed IN with elastic HOLD only (never timeScale):
    IN_BASE = 1.1s  the curtains gather and part
    HOLD    = max(0, D - IN); the stage stands revealed, still
    If D < IN_BASE, IN compresses to D (no hold).

  Determinism: no randomness anywhere in this primitive. Fold widths are a
  fixed table, the pelmet trim is a closed-form sine wave sampled at a fixed
  point count, and every fold's pose is a closed-form function of one tweened
  draw progress. Any seek order lands identical frames.

  Mount contract: the runtime clones only this template. #root fills the
  host box (no data-width/data-height, container-type: size, cqmin units),
  is styled via #root only, and registers one paused timeline under the
  LITERAL "curtain-reveal" key.
-->
<html
  lang="en"
  data-composition-id="curtain-reveal"
  data-composition-duration="2.4"
  data-composition-variables='[
    { "id": "tone", "type": "enum", "role": "style", "label": "Curtain tone", "description": "Curtain color.", "default": "burgundy", "options": [{ "value": "red", "label": "Red" }, { "value": "burgundy", "label": "Burgundy" }, { "value": "navy", "label": "Navy" }, { "value": "forest", "label": "Forest" }] },
    { "id": "pelmet", "type": "enum", "role": "style", "label": "Pelmet", "description": "Static valance framing the top of the stage.", "default": "on", "options": [{ "value": "on", "label": "On" }, { "value": "off", "label": "Off" }] },
    { "id": "spotlight", "type": "enum", "role": "style", "label": "Spotlight", "description": "Soft glow blooming over the stage as the curtains part.", "default": "on", "options": [{ "value": "on", "label": "On" }, { "value": "off", "label": "Off" }] }
  ]'
>
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Curtain Reveal</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <template>
      <div id="root" data-composition-id="curtain-reveal" data-duration="2.4" data-fps="30">
        <style>
          *,
          *::before,
          *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box;
          }

          #root {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            container-type: size;
            isolation: isolate;
            color: var(--fg, #1d1b16);
            font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif);
            background: #060607;
          }

          .cvr-clip {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
          }

          .cvr-stage {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
          }

          .cvr-stage > img,
          .cvr-stage > video {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
          }

          .cvr-stage-default {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 42%, #2a2a2e 0%, #0c0c0d 78%);
          }

          .cvr-stage-default-mark {
            font-size: 4.5cqmin;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.32em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #fff;
            opacity: 0.4;
          }

          .cvr-spotlight {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(
              34% 52% at 50% 44%,
              rgba(255, 196, 128, 0.42) 0%,
              rgba(255, 196, 128, 0) 72%
            );
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
          }

          .cvr-curtain {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
          }

          .cvr-fold {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 100%;
            transform-origin: 0 0;
            border-radius: 0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 1.6cqh 1.6cqh;
            background:
              linear-gradient(
                180deg,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0%,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 16%,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 82%,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 100%
              ),
              linear-gradient(
                90deg,
                var(--cvr-fold-dark) 0%,
                var(--cvr-fold-mid) 20%,
                var(--cvr-fold-light) calc(var(--crest) - 14%),
                var(--cvr-fold-sheen) var(--crest),
                var(--cvr-fold-light) calc(var(--crest) + 10%),
                var(--cvr-fold-mid) 80%,
                var(--cvr-fold-dark) 100%
              );
          }
          .cvr-fold::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            border-radius: inherit;
            background: #000;
            opacity: var(--shade, 0);
          }
          .cvr-fold:last-child {
            box-shadow: 1.2cqw 0 2.4cqw rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
          }
          /* The right curtain lays out from the right edge. */
          .cvr-curtain-right .cvr-fold {
            left: auto;
            right: 0;
            transform-origin: 100% 0;
          }
          .cvr-curtain-right .cvr-fold:last-child {
            box-shadow: -1.2cqw 0 2.4cqw rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
          }

          .cvr-pelmet {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 11%;
            background: var(--cvr-pelmet-color, #4a0e1f);
            box-shadow: 0 0.6cqmin 1.4cqmin rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
            clip-path: var(--cvr-pelmet-hem);
          }
        </style>

        <div
          id="curtain-reveal-clip"
          class="cvr-clip clip"
          data-start="0"
          data-duration="2.4"
          data-track-index="0"
        >
          <div class="cvr-stage" id="cvr-stage">
            <div class="cvr-stage-default">
              <span class="cvr-stage-default-mark" aria-hidden="true">Stage</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="cvr-spotlight" id="cvr-spotlight"></div>

          <div class="cvr-curtain" id="cvr-curtain-left"></div>
          <div class="cvr-curtain cvr-curtain-right" id="cvr-curtain-right"></div>

          <div class="cvr-pelmet" id="cvr-pelmet"></div>
        </div>

        <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
        <script>
          (function () {
            "use strict";

            var root = document.getElementById("root");
            var stage = document.getElementById("cvr-stage");
            var spotlight = document.getElementById("cvr-spotlight");
            var curtainLeft = document.getElementById("cvr-curtain-left");
            var curtainRight = document.getElementById("cvr-curtain-right");
            var pelmet = document.getElementById("cvr-pelmet");

            var vars =
              window.__hyperframes && window.__hyperframes.getVariables
                ? window.__hyperframes.getVariables()
                : {};

            // fold: [dark, mid, light, sheen]
            var toneTable = {
              red: { fold: ["#3d0810", "#8a1a26", "#b23345", "#cc5c6e"], pelmet: "#4a0e1a" },
              burgundy: { fold: ["#2b0912", "#5c1a2c", "#7d2c42", "#a04c62"], pelmet: "#3a0f1e" },
              navy: { fold: ["#070d1f", "#152a5c", "#274a8f", "#4f72b4"], pelmet: "#0c1836" },
              forest: { fold: ["#0c1f13", "#1f4a2b", "#356b3f", "#5c9166"], pelmet: "#12291a" },
            };
            var tone = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(toneTable, vars.tone)
              ? vars.tone
              : "burgundy";
            var palette = toneTable[tone];
            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-fold-dark", palette.fold[0]);
            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-fold-mid", palette.fold[1]);
            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-fold-light", palette.fold[2]);
            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-fold-sheen", palette.fold[3]);
            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-pelmet-color", palette.pelmet);

            var pelmetOn = vars.pelmet !== "off";
            var spotlightOn = vars.spotlight !== "off";
            pelmet.style.display = pelmetOn ? "" : "none";

            // Slot. Caller templates live at the host document level (the
            // mount wipes host-clip children, and templates never render).
            var hostDoc = root.ownerDocument;
            var slotTemplate = null;
            try {
              slotTemplate = hostDoc.querySelector('template[data-slot="curtain-reveal-stage"]');
            } catch (error) {
              slotTemplate = null;
            }
            if (slotTemplate) {
              var defaultMark = stage.querySelector(".cvr-stage-default");
              if (defaultMark) defaultMark.remove();
              stage.appendChild(hostDoc.importNode(slotTemplate.content, true));
            }

            // Closed-form scalloped hem: a fixed point count sampled from a
            // sine wave, never randomised, so the trim is identical on every
            // render of every instance.
            function hemPolygon(scallops, ampPct, baseY) {
              var STEPS = 24;
              var pts = ["0% 0%", "100% 0%"];
              for (var i = 0; i <= STEPS; i += 1) {
                var t = i / STEPS;
                var y = baseY + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * scallops) * ampPct;
                pts.push((100 - t * 100).toFixed(2) + "% " + y.toFixed(2) + "%");
              }
              return "polygon(" + pts.join(", ") + ")";
            }

            root.style.setProperty("--cvr-pelmet-hem", hemPolygon(5, 14, 78));

            // Fold widths in px at 1920 wide, outer edge first. Both sum to
            // 1075 px: from 5cqw off frame to just past center.
            var PX = 100 / 1920;
            function buildCurtain(el, dir, widths) {
              var total = 0;
              var folds = widths.map(function (w, i) {
                var fold = document.createElement("div");
                fold.className = "cvr-fold";
                // Slight overlap hides seams between neighbouring folds.
                fold.style.width = w * PX + 0.2 + "cqw";
                fold.style.setProperty("--crest", 44 + ((i * 5) % 13) + "%");
                el.appendChild(fold);
                total += w;
                return { el: fold, w: w * PX, u: i / (widths.length - 1) };
              });
              return { folds: folds, dir: dir, anchor: 51 - total * PX };
            }
            var curtains = [
              buildCurtain(curtainLeft, 1, [88, 124, 70, 106, 136, 80, 112, 62, 98, 130, 69]),
              buildCurtain(curtainRight, -1, [104, 66, 128, 84, 120, 62, 100, 134, 76, 112, 89]),
            ];

            // p = eased draw progress. Folds nearer the outer edge compress
            // harder, and the hem sweeps up toward the lead edge.
            function poseCurtains(p) {
              curtains.forEach(function (c) {
                var x = c.anchor;
                c.folds.forEach(function (f) {
                  var sx = 1 - p * (0.86 - 0.16 * f.u);
                  var sy = 1 - p * 0.07 * f.u * f.u;
                  f.el.style.transform =
                    "translateX(" +
                    (c.dir * x).toFixed(3) +
                    "cqw) scale(" +
                    sx.toFixed(4) +
                    ", " +
                    sy.toFixed(4) +
                    ")";
                  f.el.style.setProperty("--shade", (0.34 * (1 - sx)).toFixed(3));
                  x += f.w * sx;
                });
              });
            }

            // Envelope: fixed IN, elastic HOLD, never time-scaled.
            var IN_BASE = 1.1;
            var duration = Math.max(0.001, parseFloat(root.dataset.duration || "2.4"));
            var IN = Math.min(IN_BASE, duration);

            gsap.set(spotlight, { opacity: 0 });

            // Seek-safe driver: GSAP assigns `p` on every render, seek()
            // included, so the setter re-poses the folds; onUpdate is
            // suppressed on seek.
            var drawn = 0;
            var draw = {};
            Object.defineProperty(draw, "p", {
              get: function () {
                return drawn;
              },
              set: function (next) {
                drawn = next;
                poseCurtains(next);
              },
            });
            poseCurtains(0);

            var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
            tl.fromTo(draw, { p: 0 }, { p: 1, duration: IN, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 0);
            if (spotlightOn) {
              // Clamped to end by IN: uncapped, start (IN * 0.25) + duration
              // (IN * 0.85) lands at IN * 1.10 -- fine while the hold covers
              // it, but a short composition that compresses the hold away
              // would push GSAP's auto-extended timeline past data-duration.
              var spotlightStart = IN * 0.25;
              var spotlightDuration = Math.min(IN * 0.85, IN - spotlightStart);
              tl.fromTo(
                spotlight,
                { opacity: 0 },
                { opacity: 0.9, duration: spotlightDuration, ease: "power1.out" },
                spotlightStart,
              );
            }
            tl.set({}, {}, duration);
            tl.seek(0);

            window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
            window.__timelines["curtain-reveal"] = tl;
          })();
        </script>
      </div>
    </template>
  </body>
</html>
```

## Variables

Every one of these has a default, so the piece works untouched. Set the ones you

| Variable | Default | Accepts | What it does |
| - | - | - | - |
| `tone` | `burgundy` | `red`, `burgundy`, `navy`, `forest` | Curtain color. |
| `pelmet` | `on` | `on`, `off` | Static valance framing the top of the stage. |
| `spotlight` | `on` | `on`, `off` | Soft glow blooming over the stage as the curtains part. |

# Cut the Curve
Source: https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog/components/cut-the-curve

A velocity-matched directional hard cut: the outgoing subject accelerates with power4.in, swaps at peak velocity, and the incoming subject continues in the same direction with power4.out.

# Cut the Curve

A velocity-matched directional hard cut: the outgoing subject accelerates with power4.in, swaps at peak velocity, and the incoming subject continues in the same direction with power4.out.

**Cut the Curve**

```html cut-the-curve.html theme={null}
<!doctype html>
<!--
  cut-the-curve -- HyperFrames video primitive (transitions / bridge)

  Concept: a velocity-matched directional hard cut. The outgoing subject
  accelerates along one straight screen vector with power4.in. At peak
  velocity, the timeline swaps identities. The incoming subject starts on
  the far side of the same vector and decelerates to rest with power4.out.
  Matched blur and opacity at the cut conceal the seam.

  Compiled from the launch write-up for this piece.
  The source identifies the production signature as a single power4 whip,
  with an approximately 1:2 outgoing-to-incoming distance and duration split.

  Use when: bridging attention and momentum between shots, UI states, cards,
  cursor beats, or scene blocks without requiring object identity to persist.

  Variables (declared in data-composition-variables below):
    - subject ("cursor" | "card" | "scene", default "cursor") selects the
      simple visual payload used for both sides of the cut.
    - direction ("left" | "right" | "up" | "down", default "left") owns
      both the motion axis and the shared screen direction.
    - cutFraction (number, 0-1, default 0.33) sets the hard-cut point. The
      incoming distance is derived from this fraction so seam velocity stays
      matched. At 0 or 1, the corresponding zero-duration half collapses.
    - blurPx (number, default 12) sets blur at the cut seam.
    - exit ("none" | "fade" | "up", default "none") optionally departs the
      incoming subject at the end. Enabling it reserves a short tail window
      (min(0.35s, 25% of D)) after the incoming subject lands.

  Envelope (transition profile, no elastic HOLD; T = D minus the exit tail,
  which is 0 when exit is none):
    OUT = T * cutFraction, power4.in
    IN  = T * (1 - cutFraction), power4.out
    The default 0.33 split is approximately 1:2 in time. Incoming distance is
    derived from OUT distance and the duration ratio, preserving the same
    approximately 1:2 spatial split and matching velocity at the cut.

  Sync point: CUT_AT = T * cutFraction, the fixed boundary between OUT and
  IN. It never lands in a HOLD because this profile has no HOLD phase.

  Sound cue: a short whip cut fires at CUT_AT. The primitive never plays
  audio. It dispatches an `hf:sfx` CustomEvent with
  { id: "whip-cut", t: CUT_AT } for the scene mix stage to route.

  EDIT ZONE: change only the subject geometry custom properties in the style
  block when adapting the payload drawings. The vector ratios and the paired
  power4 eases are the mechanic and must remain together.

  INVARIANTS: outgoing and incoming always share one vector; the identity swap
  happens only at CUT_AT; their blur and opacity values match at that seam;
  exactly one paused timeline registers under the literal id "cut-the-curve".

  RETIME RANGE: 0.3s to 3s. Retiming changes D only. Never timeScale the GSAP
  timeline and never split the two halves into independently tuned velocities.

  Mount contract: this is a template-wrapped sub-composition. Everything the
  mount needs, including styles, markup, GSAP, and timeline registration,
  lives inside <template>. #root fills the host box with position:absolute,
  inset:0, and container-type:size. It has no data-width or data-height.
-->

        <script>
          (function () {
            "use strict";

            var root = document.getElementById("root");
            var outgoing = root.querySelector(".is-outgoing");
            var incoming = root.querySelector(".is-incoming");
            var vars =
              window.__hyperframes && window.__hyperframes.getVariables
                ? window.__hyperframes.getVariables()
                : {};

            var subject =
              vars.subject === "card" || vars.subject === "scene" ? vars.subject : "cursor";
            var direction =
              vars.direction === "right" || vars.direction === "up" || vars.direction === "down"
                ? vars.direction
                : "left";
            var rawCut = Number(vars.cutFraction);
            var cutFraction = Number.isFinite(rawCut) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rawCut)) : 0.33;
            var rawBlur = Number(vars.blurPx);
            var blurPx = Number.isFinite(rawBlur) ? Math.max(0, rawBlur) : 12;
            var exit = vars.exit === "fade" || vars.exit === "up" ? vars.exit : "none";

            root.dataset.subject = subject;

            // Direction is the single owner of axis, sign, unit, and base travel.
            var vectors = {
              left: { axis: "x", sign: -1, unit: "cqw", distance: 34 },
              right: { axis: "x", sign: 1, unit: "cqw", distance: 34 },
              up: { axis: "y", sign: -1, unit: "cqh", distance: 26 },
              down: { axis: "y", sign: 1, unit: "cqh", distance: 26 },
            };
            var vector = vectors[direction];
            var duration = Math.max(0.001, parseFloat(root.dataset.duration || "1"));
            // Exit none keeps the whole duration for the cut profile. An
            // enabled exit reserves a short tail after the incoming lands.
            var EXIT = exit === "none" ? 0 : Math.min(0.35, duration * 0.25);
            var TRAVEL = Math.max(0.001, duration - EXIT);
            var CUT_AT = TRAVEL * cutFraction;
            var ENTRY_DURATION = TRAVEL - CUT_AT;
            var entryDistance =
              CUT_AT > 0 ? vector.distance * (ENTRY_DURATION / CUT_AT) : vector.distance * 2;
            var seamBlur = "blur(" + blurPx + "px)";
            var clearBlur = "blur(0px)";
            var seamOpacity = 0.72;

            var outgoingEnd = { opacity: seamOpacity, filter: seamBlur };
            outgoingEnd[vector.axis] = vector.sign * vector.distance + vector.unit;

            var incomingStart = { x: 0, y: 0, opacity: 0, filter: seamBlur };
            incomingStart[vector.axis] = -vector.sign * entryDistance + vector.unit;

            var incomingEnd = { opacity: 1, filter: clearBlur };
            incomingEnd[vector.axis] = 0;

            gsap.set(outgoing, { x: 0, y: 0, opacity: 1, filter: clearBlur });
            gsap.set(incoming, incomingStart);

            var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

            if (CUT_AT > 0) {
              tl.to(
                outgoing,
                Object.assign({}, outgoingEnd, { duration: CUT_AT, ease: "power4.in" }),
                0,
              );
            }

            // CUT: one visibility owner, matched blur and opacity on both sides.
            tl.set(outgoing, { opacity: 0 }, CUT_AT);
            tl.set(incoming, { opacity: seamOpacity }, CUT_AT);
            tl.call(
              function () {
                root.dispatchEvent(
                  new CustomEvent("hf:sfx", {
                    detail: { id: "whip-cut", t: CUT_AT },
                    bubbles: true,
                  }),
                );
              },
              [],
              CUT_AT,
            );

            if (ENTRY_DURATION > 0) {
              tl.to(
                incoming,
                Object.assign({}, incomingEnd, {
                  duration: ENTRY_DURATION,
                  ease: "power4.out",
                }),
                CUT_AT,
              );
            } else {
              tl.set(incoming, incomingEnd, CUT_AT);
            }

            // Optional departure; exit none rests until the frame cuts.
            if (exit === "fade") {
              tl.to(incoming, { opacity: 0, duration: EXIT, ease: "power2.in" }, TRAVEL);
            } else if (exit === "up") {
              tl.to(
                incoming,
                { opacity: 0, y: "-6cqh", duration: EXIT, ease: "power2.in" },
                TRAVEL,
              );
            }

            tl.seek(0);

            window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
            window.__timelines["cut-the-curve"] = tl;
          })();
        </script>
      </div>
    </template>
  </body>
</html>
```

Copy npx hyperframes add cut-the-curve to the clipboard

That writes one file: `compositions/components/cut-the-curve.html`.

## Paste it into your composition

Open `compositions/components/cut-the-curve.html` and copy what is inside into your own composition.

A component has no size or duration of its own. It takes both from the composition
you paste it into.

## Variables

Every one of these has a default, so the piece works untouched. Set the ones you
want to change on the element:

| Variable | Default | Accepts | What it does |
| - | - | - | - |
| `subject` | `cursor` | `cursor`, `card`, `scene` | Visual payload used on both sides of the cut. |
| `direction` | `left` | `left`, `right`, `up`, `down` | Shared screen direction for outgoing and incoming travel. |
| `cutFraction` | `0.33` | 0 to 1, step 0.01 | Normalized point where the hard cut swaps subjects. |
| `blurPx` | `12` | 0px to 40px, step 1px | Blur in pixels shared by both subjects at the cut seam. |
| `exit` | `none` | `none`, `fade`, `up` | Optional departure of the incoming subject. Default none: it rests until the frame cuts. |

Set them with `data-variable-values` on the element that mounts it. These are the
defaults, so this behaves exactly like the preview above until you change one:

```html wrap theme={null}
<div
  data-composition-id="cut-the-curve"
  data-composition-src="compositions/components/cut-the-curve.html"
  data-variable-values='{"subject":"cursor","direction":"left","cutFraction":0.33,"blurPx":12,"exit":"none"}'
></div>
```

Tagged `transition` `directional-cut` `velocity-match` `whip` `bridge` `demonstrate`.

# Dart Cursor

A bold outlined arrowhead that dives in from camera depth, flies nose-first with motion blur along its path, squashes on two clicks, and whips out of frame.

**Dart Cursor**

```html dart-cursor.html theme={null}
<!doctype html>
<!--
  Dart Cursor (actor primitive), mountable sub-composition

  concept: a bold outlined arrowhead that dives in from camera depth, flies nose-first
  like a dart (it turns to face where it travels and relaxes upright when it parks),
  smears with motion blur along its path, squashes on each click, and whips out.

  mount contract: loaded by a host through data-composition-src; only <template> is
  cloned. #root fills the host clip (inset:0). See demo.html.

  variables:
    tone (dark|light)                   dark body with a white outline, or the reverse
    target_x, target_y (% of host box)  where the tip lands for the first click
    target2_x, target2_y (%)            where it lands for the second click
    enter_from, exit_to (left|right|top|bottom)  the edge it arrives from and leaves by
    blur (0 to 1.5)                     motion-blur strength, 0 turns it off

  envelope (default 3.6s): entry 0-0.6s, click 0.7s, move 1.0-1.55s, click 1.7s,
  hold, exit in the last 0.55s. Shorter durations compress every beat evenly.
-->

  lang="en"

    { "id": "blur", "type": "number", "role": "style", "label": "Motion blur", "default": 1, "min": 0, "max": 1.5, "step": 0.1 }

  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />

    <template>
      <style>
        #root {

          left: 0;

          width: 0;

        /* The tip sits at the svg origin, so the wrapper's translate places the tip. */
        .dc-svg {
          position: absolute;

          top: -120px;
          width: 240px;
          height: 240px;
          overflow: visible;
        }

        .dc-outline {
          stroke-width: 22;
          stroke-linejoin: round;
        }
        .dc-body {
          stroke-width: 3;
          stroke-linejoin: round;
        }
        .dc-cursor[data-tone="dark"] .dc-outline {
          fill: #ffffff;
          stroke: #ffffff;
        }
        .dc-cursor[data-tone="dark"] .dc-body {
          fill: #0b0b0c;
          stroke: #0b0b0c;
        }
        .dc-cursor[data-tone="light"] .dc-outline {
          fill: #111113;
          stroke: #111113;
        }
        .dc-cursor[data-tone="light"] .dc-body {
          fill: #ffffff;
          stroke: #ffffff;
        }
      </style>

      <div id="root" data-composition-id="dart-cursor" data-duration="3.6">
        <div class="dc-cursor" id="dc-cursor" data-tone="dark" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg class="dc-svg" viewBox="-120 -120 240 240" aria-hidden="true">
            <defs>
              <filter
                id="dc-smear"
                x="-100%"
                y="-100%"
                width="300%"
                height="300%"
                color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
              >
                <feGaussianBlur id="dc-smear-fe" stdDeviation="0 0" />
              </filter>
            </defs>
            <g id="dc-spin">
              <g id="dc-heading" filter="url(#dc-smear)">
                <g id="dc-unheading">
                  <g id="dc-shape">
                    <polygon
                      class="dc-outline"
                      points="-5,1 -14,82 -11,83 6,64 20,58 34,57 53,62 49,52 0,0"
                    />
                    <polygon
                      class="dc-body"
                      points="-5,1 -14,82 -11,83 6,64 20,58 34,57 53,62 49,52 0,0"
                    />
                  </g>
                </g>
              </g>
            </g>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>

      <script>
        (function () {
          "use strict";

          var html = document.documentElement;
          var root = document.getElementById("root");
          var cursor = document.getElementById("dc-cursor");
          var svg = cursor.querySelector(".dc-svg");
          var spin = document.getElementById("dc-spin");
          var heading = document.getElementById("dc-heading");
          var unheading = document.getElementById("dc-unheading");
          var shape = document.getElementById("dc-shape");
          var smear = document.getElementById("dc-smear-fe");

          var DEFAULTS = {};
          try {
            JSON.parse(html.getAttribute("data-composition-variables") || "[]").forEach(
              function (variable) {
                DEFAULTS[variable.id] = variable.default;
              },
            );
          } catch (error) {
            /* malformed declaration falls back to the inline defaults below */
          }
          var scopedVariables = {};
          try {
            if (window.__hyperframes && typeof window.__hyperframes.getVariables === "function") {
              scopedVariables = window.__hyperframes.getVariables() || {};
            }
          } catch (error) {
            /* no scoped variables API in this context */
          }
          var vars = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, window.__hfVariables || {}, scopedVariables);

          function num(value, fallback, lo, hi) {
            var n = Number(value);
            if (!isFinite(n)) n = fallback;
            return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));
          }
          function side(value, fallback) {
            return ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"].indexOf(value) >= 0 ? value : fallback;
          }

          // Hardcoded: the compositor rewrites the wrapper's attributes on mount.
          var compositionId = "dart-cursor";
          var duration = Math.max(
            0.001,
            parseFloat(
              root.dataset.duration || html.getAttribute("data-composition-duration") || "3.6",
            ),
          );
          var tone = vars.tone === "light" ? "light" : "dark";
          var blurAmount = num(vars.blur, 1, 0, 1.5);
          var W = root.clientWidth || 1920;
          var H = root.clientHeight || 1080;
          var unit = W / 1920;
          // The glyph is 105 units tall with its outline: 80 px at 1920 wide.
          var PX_PER_SVG_UNIT = (80 / 105) * unit;

          function stagePoint(xPercent, yPercent) {
            return { x: (xPercent / 100) * W, y: (yPercent / 100) * H };
          }
          var A = stagePoint(num(vars.target_x, 34, 0, 100), num(vars.target_y, 58, 0, 100));
          var B = stagePoint(num(vars.target2_x, 64, 0, 100), num(vars.target2_y, 46, 0, 100));
          function offStage(edge, near) {
            if (edge === "left") return { x: -0.14 * W, y: near.y - 0.18 * H };
            if (edge === "top") return { x: near.x + 0.16 * W, y: -0.2 * H };
            if (edge === "bottom") return { x: near.x - 0.12 * W, y: 1.22 * H };
            return { x: 1.14 * W, y: near.y - 0.22 * H };
          }
          var START = offStage(side(vars.enter_from, "right"), A);
          var END = offStage(side(vars.exit_to, "right"), B);

          // Beats at the default 3.6s; a shorter composition compresses them evenly.
          var FIXED_TAIL = 0.55 + 0.35;
          var squeeze = Math.min(1, duration / (1.7 + FIXED_TAIL));
          var T_LAND1 = 0.6 * squeeze;
          var T_CLICK1 = 0.7 * squeeze;
          var T_MOVE = 1.0 * squeeze;
          var T_LAND2 = 1.55 * squeeze;
          var T_CLICK2 = 1.7 * squeeze;
          var T_EXIT = Math.max(T_CLICK2 + 0.3 * squeeze, duration - 0.55 * squeeze);

          function clamp01(u) {
            return u < 0 ? 0 : u > 1 ? 1 : u;
          }
          function smooth(u) {
            u = clamp01(u);
            return u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
          }
          var easeOut = gsap.parseEase("power3.out");
          var easeInOut = gsap.parseEase("power2.inOut");
          var easeIn = gsap.parseEase("power3.in");

          // A quadratic arc bent to one side of the chord.
          function arc(p0, p1, bend, u) {
            var cx = (p0.x + p1.x) / 2 - (p1.y - p0.y) * bend;
            var cy = (p0.y + p1.y) / 2 + (p1.x - p0.x) * bend;
            var v = 1 - u;
            return {
              x: v * v * p0.x + 2 * v * u * cx + u * u * p1.x,
              y: v * v * p0.y + 2 * v * u * cy + u * u * p1.y,
            };
          }

          function positionAt(t) {
            if (t <= T_LAND1) return arc(START, A, 0.22, easeOut(clamp01(t / T_LAND1)));
            if (t <= T_MOVE) return A;
            if (t <= T_LAND2) {
              return arc(A, B, -0.18, easeInOut(clamp01((t - T_MOVE) / (T_LAND2 - T_MOVE))));
            }
            if (t <= T_EXIT) return B;
            return arc(B, END, 0.12, easeIn(clamp01((t - T_EXIT) / (duration - T_EXIT))));
          }

          function keyed(keys, u) {
            if (u <= keys[0][0]) return keys[0][1];
            for (var i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {
              if (u <= keys[i][0]) {
                var a = keys[i - 1];
                var b = keys[i];
                return a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * smooth((u - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]));
              }
            }
            return keys[keys.length - 1][1];
          }
          var DIVE = [
            [0, 1.3],
            [0.4, 1.8],
            [0.78, 1.06],
            [1, 1],
          ];
          function press(t, at) {
            var down = 0.08 * squeeze;
            var up = 0.2 * squeeze;
            if (t < at) return 0;
            if (t < at + down) return 0.2 * gsap.parseEase("power2.in")((t - at) / down);
            return 0.2 - 0.1 * gsap.parseEase("power2.out")(clamp01((t - at - down) / up));
          }

          // Depth is scale: above 1 is lifted toward camera, below 1 is pressed into the screen.
          function depthAt(t) {
            if (t <= T_LAND1) return keyed(DIVE, t / T_LAND1);
            if (t <= T_MOVE) return 1 - press(t, T_CLICK1);
            if (t <= T_LAND2) {
              var u = (t - T_MOVE) / (T_LAND2 - T_MOVE);
              return 0.9 + 0.1 * smooth(u / 0.3) + 0.07 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u);
            }
            return 1 - press(t, T_CLICK2);
          }

          // Local-frame nose angle of the arrowhead (tip minus the shape's centroid).
          var NOSE_DEG = -106;
          var H_STEP = 1 / 120;
          function wrap(deg) {
            return ((((deg + 180) % 360) + 360) % 360) - 180;
          }

          function render(t) {
            var p = positionAt(t);
            var before = positionAt(Math.max(0, t - H_STEP));
            var after = positionAt(Math.min(duration, t + H_STEP));
            var vx = (after.x - before.x) / (2 * H_STEP);
            var vy = (after.y - before.y) / (2 * H_STEP);
            var speed = Math.hypot(vx, vy) / unit;
            var travelDeg = (Math.atan2(vy, vx) * 180) / Math.PI;
            var steer = smooth((speed - 150) / 950);
            var rotation = steer * wrap(travelDeg - NOSE_DEG);
            var depth = depthAt(t);
            var exiting = t > T_EXIT;
            var perFrame = speed / 60;
            var smearUnits =
              blurAmount * Math.min(exiting ? 36 : 12, (exiting ? 0.28 : 0.16) * perFrame);
            var lift = Math.max(0, depth - 0.9);

            cursor.style.transform = "translate(" + p.x.toFixed(2) + "px," + p.y.toFixed(2) + "px)";
            svg.style.filter =
              "drop-shadow(0 " +
              (3 + 22 * lift).toFixed(1) +
              "px " +
              (4 + 26 * lift).toFixed(1) +
              "px rgba(0,0,0," +
              (0.34 - 0.12 * Math.min(1, lift)).toFixed(3) +
              "))";
            spin.setAttribute(
              "transform",
              "rotate(" +
                rotation.toFixed(2) +
                ") scale(" +
                (depth * PX_PER_SVG_UNIT).toFixed(4) +
                ")",
            );
            // The blur's x axis is turned onto the travel direction, then the shape turned back.
            var local = wrap(travelDeg - rotation);
            heading.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + local.toFixed(2) + ")");
            unheading.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + (-local).toFixed(2) + ")");
            smear.setAttribute("stdDeviation", smearUnits.toFixed(3) + " 0");
            cursor.style.opacity = t >= duration ? "0" : "1";
          }

          cursor.setAttribute("data-tone", tone);
          shape.setAttribute("transform", "scale(1.09 1)");

          var clock = { t: 0 };
          var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
          tl.to(
            clock,
            {
              t: duration,
              duration: duration,
              ease: "none",
              onUpdate: function () {
                render(clock.t);
              },
            },
            0,
          );
          render(0);
          tl.seek(0);
          window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
          window.__timelines[compositionId] = tl;
        })();
      </script>
    </template>
  </body>
</html>
```

Copy npx hyperframes add dart-cursor to the clipboard

That writes one file: `compositions/components/dart-cursor.html`.

## Paste it into your composition

Open `compositions/components/dart-cursor.html` and copy what is inside into your own composition.

A component has no size or duration of its own. It takes both from the composition
you paste it into.

## Variables

Every one of these has a default, so the piece works untouched. Set the ones you
want to change on the element:

| Variable | Default | Accepts | What it does |
| - | - | - | - |
| `tone` | `dark` | `dark`, `light` | |
| `target_x` | `34` | 5% to 95%, step 1% | |
| `target_y` | `58` | 5% to 95%, step 1% | |
| `target2_x` | `64` | 5% to 95%, step 1% | |
| `target2_y` | `46` | 5% to 95%, step 1% | |
| `enter_from` | `right` | `right`, `left`, `top`, `bottom` | |
| `exit_to` | `right` | `right`, `left`, `top`, `bottom` | |
| `blur` | `1` | 0 to 1.5, step 0.1 | |

Set them with `data-variable-values` on the element that mounts it. These are the
defaults, so this behaves exactly like the preview above until you change one:

```html wrap theme={null}
<div
  data-composition-id="dart-cursor"
  data-composition-src="compositions/components/dart-cursor.html"
  data-variable-values='{"tone":"dark","target_x":34,"target_y":58,"target2_x":64,"target2_y":46,"enter_from":"right","exit_to":"right","blur":1}'
></div>
```

Tagged `cursor` `motion-primitive` `pointer` `click` `motion-blur` `depth`.

# Decline Chart
Source: https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog/components/decline-chart

A metric line draws downward as its value counts down and the ambient background darkens in lockstep.

# Decline Chart

A metric line draws downward as its value counts down and the ambient background darkens in lockstep.

**Decline Chart**

```html decline-chart.html theme={null}
<!doctype html>
<!--
  decline-chart: HyperFrames video primitive

  One metric line draws downward while its numeric value counts down and the
  ambient background dims and desaturates from the same progress value.

  Envelope:
    IN_BASE  = 0.55s  chart frame settles into view
    HOLD     = elastic decline draw, countdown, and ambient darkening
    OUT_BASE = 0.45s  bottomed-out endpoint locks in with no recovery
    If D is shorter than IN_BASE + OUT_BASE, IN and OUT compress together
    and HOLD collapses to zero. Longer mounts stretch HOLD only.

  Variables:
    label       (string, default "Retention")
    start_value (number, default 82)
    end_value   (number, default 34)
-->
<html
  lang="en"
  data-composition-id="decline-chart"
  data-composition-duration="4"
  data-composition-variables='[
    { "id": "label", "type": "string", "role": "content", "label": "Metric label", "description": "Label shown above the declining value.", "default": "Retention" },
    { "id": "start_value", "type": "number", "role": "content", "label": "Start value", "description": "Metric value at the start of the decline.", "default": 82, "min": 0, "max": 100, "step": 1 },
    { "id": "end_value", "type": "number", "role": "content", "label": "End value", "description": "Metric value at the bottom of the decline.", "default": 34, "min": 0, "max": 100, "step": 1 }
  ]'
>
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Decline Chart</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <template>
      <div id="root" data-composition-id="decline-chart" data-duration="4" data-fps="30">
        <style>
          *,
          *::before,
          *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box;
          }

          #root {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            container-type: size;
            isolation: isolate;
            color: var(--fg, #f8fafc);
            font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif);
            pointer-events: none;
          }

          .dc-clip,
          .dc-ambient,
          .dc-gloom {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
          }

          .dc-clip {
            overflow: hidden;
          }

          .dc-ambient {
            background:
              radial-gradient(circle at 24% 16%, rgba(47, 129, 150, 0.55), transparent 46%),
              linear-gradient(145deg, #152f3c 0%, #101a25 48%, #0c1118 100%);
            transform: scale(1.02);
            transform-origin: center;
            will-change: filter;
          }

          .dc-gloom {
            background: #030507;
            opacity: 0;
          }

          .dc-layout {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 9cqh 9cqw 8cqh;
            display: grid;
            /* minmax(0, 1fr): a bare 1fr row inflates to the svg's intrinsic
               aspect height (min-height auto), overflowing the card. */
            grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
            gap: 5cqh;
            opacity: 0;
          }

          .dc-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: end;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 5cqw;
          }

          .dc-label {
            max-width: 58cqw;
            overflow: hidden;
            color: rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.72);
            font-size: clamp(12px, 3.6cqh, 38px);
            font-weight: 620;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            line-height: 1.1;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }

          .dc-value {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            color: #f8fafc;
            font-family: var(--font-display, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif);
            font-size: clamp(30px, 12cqh, 118px);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            font-weight: 760;
            letter-spacing: -0.07em;
            line-height: 0.8;
          }

          .dc-chart {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: visible;
          }

          .dc-grid {
            stroke: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
            stroke-width: 1;
            vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
          }

          .dc-line {
            fill: none;
            stroke: #fb7185;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
            /* No non-scaling-stroke here: with preserveAspectRatio=none Chromium
               applies the dash pattern in screen space, so the user-space
               dasharray from getTotalLength() splits the draw into two visible
               segments. Scaled stroke keeps dashes in user space. */
            stroke-width: 4;
          }

          .dc-endpoint {
            fill: #fecdd3;
            opacity: 0;
            transform-box: fill-box;
            transform-origin: center;
          }
        </style>

        <div
          id="decline-chart-clip"
          class="dc-clip clip"
          data-start="0"
          data-duration="4"
          data-track-index="0"

          <div class="dc-gloom"></div>

              class="dc-chart"
              viewBox="0 0 260 240"
              preserveAspectRatio="none"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <line class="dc-grid" x1="8" y1="55" x2="252" y2="55"></line>
              <line class="dc-grid" x1="8" y1="120" x2="252" y2="120"></line>
              <line class="dc-grid" x1="8" y1="185" x2="252" y2="185"></line>
              <path
                class="dc-line"
                d="M 8 24 C 28 28, 44 43, 61 56 S 93 76, 112 92 S 144 111, 163 134 S 193 159, 213 186 S 239 211, 252 222"
              ></path>

        <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
        <script>
          (function () {
            "use strict";

            var root = document.getElementById("root");
            var layout = root.querySelector(".dc-layout");
            var ambient = root.querySelector(".dc-ambient");
            var gloom = root.querySelector(".dc-gloom");
            var label = root.querySelector(".dc-label");
            var value = root.querySelector(".dc-value");
            var line = root.querySelector(".dc-line");
            var endpoint = root.querySelector(".dc-endpoint");
            var lineLength = line.getTotalLength();
            var vars =
              window.__hyperframes && window.__hyperframes.getVariables
                ? window.__hyperframes.getVariables()
                : {};

            line.style.strokeDasharray = lineLength + " " + lineLength;

            var startValue = Number.isFinite(vars.start_value) ? vars.start_value : 82;
            var endValue = Number.isFinite(vars.end_value) ? vars.end_value : 34;
            var labelText = vars.label == null ? "Retention" : String(vars.label);

            label.textContent = labelText;

            var IN_BASE = 0.55;
            var OUT_BASE = 0.45;
            var duration = Math.max(0.001, parseFloat(root.dataset.duration || "4"));
            var fixedTotal = IN_BASE + OUT_BASE;
            var phaseScale = duration < fixedTotal ? duration / fixedTotal : 1;
            var IN = IN_BASE * phaseScale;
            var OUT = OUT_BASE * phaseScale;
            var HOLD = Math.max(0, duration - IN - OUT);
            var OUT_START = IN + HOLD;
            var progress = { value: 0 };

            function renderProgress() {
              var p = progress.value;
              line.style.strokeDashoffset = String(lineLength * (1 - p));
              ambient.style.filter =
                "saturate(" + (1 - p * 0.72) + ") brightness(" + (1 - p * 0.52) + ")";
              gloom.style.opacity = String(p * 0.46);
              endpoint.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0, (p - 0.94) / 0.06));
              value.textContent = String(Math.round(startValue + (endValue - startValue) * p));
            }

            renderProgress();

            var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
            tl.fromTo(
              layout,
              { opacity: 0, y: "2.5cqh" },
              { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: IN, ease: "power2.out" },
              0,
            );

            if (HOLD > 0) {
              tl.to(
                progress,
                { value: 1, duration: HOLD, ease: "power2.out", onUpdate: renderProgress },
                IN,
              );
            } else {
              tl.call(
                function () {
                  progress.value = 1;
                  renderProgress();
                },
                [],
                IN,
              );
            }

            tl.fromTo(
              endpoint,
              { scale: 0.72 },
              { scale: 1, duration: OUT, ease: "power2.out" },
              OUT_START,
            );

            tl.seek(0);
            window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
            window.__timelines["decline-chart"] = tl;
          })();
        </script>
      </div>
    </template>
  </body>
</html>
```
