# Weekly updates
Source: https://hyperframes.heygen.com/weekly-updates

Curated weekly highlights for HyperFrames.

Weekly HyperFrames highlights across releases, examples, docs, and community updates.

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

**Week of October 26, 2026**

Weekly digest - October 26, 2026 - November 2, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Oct26 Nov02" />

HyperFrames 0.9 is out. Distributed renders on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run now run only on Plan v2, so upgrade the SDK and your deployment together. Renders take a time range and a ProRes profile, and they got faster on Macs, in containers and with `--gpu`. Playback in Safari and on iPhone is much steadier. The Studio app comes to Windows. v0.8.205 through v0.9.5 shipped.

## HyperFrames 0.9: Plan v2 only

v0.9.0 is a breaking release. Distributed rendering on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run runs only on Plan v2. The Plan v1 transport, the `planProtocol` option and the Plan v1 event and result types are gone ([7f48a6894](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f48a6894c42426ae9bc8a913879d4cd0fb72166), [#6970](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6970)). When you move your app to the 0.9 SDK, redeploy your Lambda stack or Cloud Run service from 0.9 too. Drop `planProtocol` from `renderToLambda` and `renderToCloudRun` calls. Passing `"v1"` now throws, and a 0.9 handler answers an old v1 event with `PLAN_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED`. The [v0.9.0 release notes](/changelog) list every removed export. A Lambda render started straight on the state machine with no `PlanProtocol` runs as Plan v2 ([758759673](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/758759673bdd12ef007fc7315ecca1c721875f5a), [#6985](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6985)).

## Render controls

`hyperframes render --start <s> --end <s>` renders only that span of the film, with its audio, as an MP4 that starts at 0 ([5a164fb36](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a164fb3693d522ef163570bde82b10af47d2322), [#6834](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6834)). `--prores-profile` picks ProRes 4444, hq, 422, lt or proxy for MOV ([957df5c26](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/957df5c268c6622c94879a701c845d35d72d1762), [#6581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6581)). `--keyframe-interval`, `--max-bitrate` and `--buffer-size` reach the final encode, so a delivery file needs no second ffmpeg pass ([54d0af57e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/54d0af57ebe9874d12f7f4b9bebc02ef47713893), [#6444](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6444)). A render with no `-o` writes to the project's renders folder from any directory ([aa094f385](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa094f385838cbaca4f85036a6cbe5905c88f2ee), [#6766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6766)).

An export that passes the loudness ceiling now comes down peak by peak, so quiet passages keep their level ([d1d631f60](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1d631f60a6cc949c572831927c7fe86455b21f8), [#6940](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6940)). If a render still has to lower the whole mix, it says so and says how to keep the level ([f9e8cab67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9e8cab67d948adbc115d3f3a0b271659e2521da), [#6938](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6938)). HDR sources are tone-mapped for formats that cannot carry HDR ([313792408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/313792408d641f702ea7624fd6abda10c957aab3), [#6597](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6597)), and auto renders with colour-graded media stay SDR ([60f711686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60f711686ccae602caaed24faa3e225be6d96b12), [#6671](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6671)). HEIC images are converted to JPEG when the project compiles ([ad4d3fad1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ad4d3fad139490104f5bbeba66a2892c609e37fc), [#6455](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6455)). A multi-worker or chunked render lands every frame where an in-order render does ([fa9acbd73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa9acbd7399b7cd5ca9940399d9066bb33d96973), [#6707](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6707)).

## Faster renders

High quality MP4s encode with the x264 fast preset ([be05c8693](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be05c86932be215ec70621dc568af96415555fa0), [#6640](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6640)). Worker sizing uses measured memory budgets and reads a container's CPU quota, so a render in a 10 GB container captures with three workers instead of one ([cd003e201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd003e201051317234598bcf1c70cfed4770613f), [#6641](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6641)). A 14 core Mac with 24 GB of memory and a hardware GPU captures with 8 workers instead of 4, and a 5 minute film renders 43% faster ([e6476c2cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e6476c2cd57d8e605ca4d25f6c8b4fef6fdb322e), [#6636](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6636)). `--gpu` renders encode while frames are still being captured ([6553b1f6b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6553b1f6ba75582c0a2d0830cf74a84c434548a0), [#6631](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6631)).

The audio mix runs while capture starts its browsers ([1d97ed24c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d97ed24c647553cefb251c59b1bccc48ff4f09c), [#6632](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6632)), and a remote video downloads once per render instead of twice ([2ddf41eb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ddf41eb7d0b3aa7a8ee7d267b5090e852bc215e), [#6637](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6637)). Lambda renders with small chunks stitch their output in parallel ([51f9fa7c5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/51f9fa7c541fa2a8f57ae700d4189396058bbd62), [#6635](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6635)). For a film whose only video fills the whole canvas, `HF_VIDEO_LAYER_PASSTHROUGH=true` lets ffmpeg lay that video under the page instead of capturing it every frame. It is opt-in and off by default ([98520366a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98520366a6fccb0447a61f8e4baffa0f2568c359), [#6914](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6914)).

## Playback in Safari and on iPhone

iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound after the first seconds of an edit ([48ba0e5b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/48ba0e5b2bf91fc816adc0a7769d7344091aa5d7), [#6724](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6724)), and keeps one connection per file for the take on screen and the next ([036e41fa0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/036e41fa09e6670f155fa3f2c361b58b8ed77e02), [#7012](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7012)). Safari keeps an edit's audio playing without seeks or rate changes ([2c1a10f3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c1a10f3ad1fc2c356d3f9b4a4fd329a6900e806), [#6888](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6888)), stops chopping audio by seeking it over and over ([0c16afd94](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c16afd949f2511ca17347eaa113640df0bac1e5), [#6854](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6854)), and has audio ready at each cut ([c25e09211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c25e092114459b413d7f44df5c1ad1a05b6cee80), [#7024](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7024)). WebKit plays bare audio from a decoded buffer on the audio clock ([e181d34ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e181d34edc45e2f9590007ebf7318f8a139bf747), [#6912](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6912)).

In every browser, a video after a cut plays in sync instead of about 70 ms behind ([594df2153](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/594df21537d736d9fa5f0c212504cb51ffc4ce65), [#6494](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6494)). The first cut after Play starts on time ([07c714ce9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/07c714ce9b139500465b37174971e5f288b854a9), [#6794](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6794)), and long cut lists play every cut without dropped or late frames ([9fd90d23c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fd90d23c4cc1208965c2179cd25a6d871246df9), [#6785](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6785)). A preview video that runs short of data holds the film instead of looping snippets ([8519f2836](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8519f2836358499f36d3ba79ca3c16bc1318a97f), [#6974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6974)). The lighter copy of the video at the playhead is made before the rest ([bff39004b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bff39004b0312ed903fbe0882ec31c6d0b1a0a25), [#6586](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6586)).

## The browser editor

Long projects are faster. Films with thousands of timed clips stop re-reading every clip each frame ([d83f27674](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d83f2767436ef85260a42e6c548f9609f99b11ba), [#6805](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6805)). A long timeline stops redrawing every clip when its elements change ([6c78dee99](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c78dee99348b057b5d7a0dee01882a8e75b8481), [#6773](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6773)), and stops laying itself out on every render while it settles ([9b0df610c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9b0df610cca45bb1bc8bacec78059d3c4443ec09), [#6855](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6855)). Timeline thumbnails come back from disk in the next session ([e38585ef5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e38585ef5f5ccc831d804020d3014e2899dda204), [#6676](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6676)), and a clip's thumbnail strip stays put while you trim it ([0ab493115](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ab49311597ce1e01ae2f5e438276c5d313ba448), [#6942](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6942)).

Audio keeps playing after a timeline move or trim ([9aa6346a7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9aa6346a779328f1c0963ec3d37b856ad164c969), [#6428](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6428)). A split at a clip's edge leaves the file unchanged ([b20d0a62c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b20d0a62ce1d1c573c3344b544851875bd2b157c), [#6826](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6826)). Exports larger than 2 GiB download ([164d6c7a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/164d6c7a36eba26e9126b364beab98437e2eeec7), [#6602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6602)). Apps that embed the editor can remap every shortcut, including those with modifiers, Space and the arrow keys ([9fa02badf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fa02badfc20319a292573333c72da715c263bcf), [#6966](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6966)), and can ask which action holds a key combination ([5fca43562](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5fca435623a5005def2c3d0e5a1c4195e8084a4c), [#6979](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6979)).

## The Studio app on Windows

The CLI and the browser editor offer the HyperFrames app download on Windows, as they do on macOS and Linux ([b76b52937](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b76b529372480833a851101c24852054589ec8a4), [#6442](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6442)). `hyperframes open <dir>` hands the project to the app on Windows and Linux too ([be4e2e780](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be4e2e78065b6f3a117ada200de11c35701447ff), [#6484](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6484)). The docs have Windows install steps ([d0c54776f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d0c54776fa3008ba31f556eff0bde1c9f3b6a34a), [#6445](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6445)). hyperframes.dev moved to hyperframes.studio, and the docs link straight there ([6ae7c7688](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6ae7c7688cec29911b66936a24482b1cfb0f9589), [#6585](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6585)).

The CLI is steadier on Windows. `init` creates its files with no Developer Mode ([6dee9d144](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6dee9d144ce761863d65398c2bc3929610b0773b), [#6463](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6463)). JSON flags can come from a file or stdin, so PowerShell can pass them ([808d642bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/808d642bceec4bf98c6289914c4e4333198fdecc), [#6518](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6518)). A render opens no console windows ([6cf4b5669](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6cf4b5669703d9416d2ec276accff638d4a89ec6), [#6613](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6613)). A locked Chrome `debug.log` no longer fails check, snapshot or render ([6874cc289](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6874cc289012f31a0c9441d7fff12a277080c077), [#6771](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6771)). Undo and redo restore a file that something holds open ([30df5a48a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/30df5a48af7bc263aa6d09ba19d44a3339338b07), [#6628](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6628)).

## Check, snapshot and the CLI

`check` has an audio section. It catches audio the render would drop, refuse or play as silence ([d83bf997b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d83bf997b0b6bf073a3c764c701eb1d1819104df), [#6439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6439)). It fails a full-frame element that covers every other clip, and names it ([2a0fa7f4d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a0fa7f4de9704ef5dd8f88b0e974383914e6c3f), [#6572](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6572)). `check` and `snapshot` free the video clips the playhead has left, which halves memory on films cut from many clips ([6b3e7a7a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b3e7a7a95e11d5d290123ea821b53109d6103c9), [#6929](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6929)). `snapshot` fails when a video frame on screen cannot be read, instead of saving a black or stale frame ([b23b51f4f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b23b51f4f0b02cbe2caa8e71d2a35b4cb2f8995d), [#7011](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7011)). `--timeout` takes units like `45s` ([a669316bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a669316bf2f8ed91907a98b65c1214f4ddcd1a76), [#6521](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6521)).

`hyperframes help <cmd>` works, and an unknown command or flag suggests the closest one ([e2c915132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e2c91513203ec9be1833840bcfb35183a3dcee8d), [#6621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6621)). Commands never prompt or auto-install when nobody is at the terminal ([0bdc128cb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0bdc128cb589c99147c76a2e9a5eb4a66f4b1be2), [#6617](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6617)). Every `--json` failure answers in one shape ([85efaece7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/85efaece7e11a3e420fb4d93b85230781e805942), [#6622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6622)). A killed CLI no longer leaves its child processes running ([5148326fd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5148326fd6632a919d89649d3e7a81b8af742560), [#6431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6431)). `hyperframes beats <file>` analyses an audio or video file directly ([a37307126](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a3730712618c1b39520d760a85168178e5869ab0), [#6812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6812)), and `hyperframes doctor` names the tested ffmpeg build ([98e774384](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98e774384efdc785c7d49947948e796a8b8b4004), [#6566](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6566)). Lint warns when a `url()` in a linked stylesheet does not resolve beside it ([6cddd1a24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6cddd1a24043ce852bcca3e4cf59378a02d400d1), [#6844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6844)).

## Colour grading

Grade groups grade a whole lane from one `<hf-color-group>`. Clips join it with `data-color-group`, so grading a camera cut into hundreds of clips means editing one attribute ([09b129047](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09b12904748b71ab1777d335f20026d45d6944ca), [#6678](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6678)). Core can bake a grade into a 3D LUT `.cube` file that matches the preview at the LUT's sample points ([c9017f45f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9017f45f4b8c38e11396a70a3d05d3432c58b48), [#6679](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6679)). 65 point `.cube` LUTs, the size grading apps export, are accepted ([9284e69ff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9284e69fff2af4928d41cc376f36d5cfbd789bfd), [#6921](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6921)). A graded clip no longer comes out blank on a real GPU ([9eaf9efb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9eaf9efb69f37de0d6d98324bda1c65c9a924f2f), [#6615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6615)).

## Skills

`/reverse-any-video` rebuilds a video file as an editable HyperFrames project, checked frame by frame against the original ([f2358315e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f2358315e59731833334c5d881a7fb5543c22a97), [#6833](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6833)). It needs HyperFrames Pro and installs on demand ([8089f0049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8089f0049ca68bd1f8f88d77838fa34f0459f869), [#7006](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7006)). On a paid HyperFrames plan, the skills render the final cut in the cloud, while previews and drafts stay local ([2b76e9a70](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b76e9a70a749c445cd137946512b0dda8aa770f), [#6884](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6884)). `media-use generate --voice` also takes a language, such as `--voice Chinese` ([8089f0049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8089f0049ca68bd1f8f88d77838fa34f0459f869), [#7006](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7006)).

## Sign-in, privacy and security

The CLI signs in with its own HyperFrames login, kept in `~/.hyperframes`, so another CLI can no longer overwrite it. Run `hyperframes auth login` once after you upgrade ([3e462f427](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e462f427723e81352fea956b155848428cf1319), [#6687](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6687)). Signed-in CLI usage is identified by your HyperFrames user id, and the docs no longer call signed-in usage anonymous ([1c3fcf4d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1c3fcf4d237d031107baa6a5646b5bb1ee82cc2a), [#6703](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6703)). Downloads refuse hosts that resolve to private addresses ([9830059bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9830059bdb08adbab473d059d1b6db2230a5bb15), [#6571](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6571)). A project's `.env` only sets the CLI's own settings ([838f8782c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/838f8782c4a96913d1627cd344be8431e7c44019), [#6565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6565)). Browser sign-in stays open through checkout ([34ddced2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/34ddced2d0e9350c2b6387b2365257bb7080e832), [#6879](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6879)).

## Docs

The Prompt Guide is six topic pages ([12030b0ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12030b0ee8bcb8dc8ba8215c13ddf9cf4030961f), [#6378](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6378)). The editor that `hyperframes preview` opens is now called the browser editor, with six pages of its own, so it is not mixed up with the Studio app ([0390f3f90](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0390f3f908d1caa24ce609f402468eb52bf0c75c), [#6379](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6379)). The top bar has one Docs menu and the Catalog ([4cee7be83](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4cee7be834c18b571da1cfcda6e3eaeca7689855), [#6860](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6860)), and the docs link the free lessons ([0163ee11a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0163ee11a75a3409b9146a642bab0f80c3bdad1b), [#6588](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6588)).

**Week of October 19, 2026**

Weekly digest - October 19, 2026 - October 26, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Oct19 26" />

Motion blur arrived this week, in renders and in the browser editor. Studio exports GIFs and plays heavy videos from lighter copies, and long films stay smooth in the preview. Lambda renders on arm64 by default and deploys straight from npm. v0.8.177 through v0.8.204 shipped.

## Motion blur

Fast-moving elements can now smear along their path ([8df2d8d95](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8df2d8d95decbab22454c632e86b41c2cde4386b), [#5875](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5875)), in the preview and in the render ([1f8ead7bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f8ead7bde73a2acb9ff1c5b6327ad0153bd09b8), [#5969](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5969)). It is opt-in: add `data-motion-blur="on"` to the composition root. The **Blur** tab in the browser editor sets it with one control, Off, Subtle or Strong, and writes the same attributes a render reads ([ffc327b44](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ffc327b44c548576bb40be2eef14bc04d7694d6f), [#6112](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6112)). The defaults match a 240 degree shutter with at least 32 samples ([79b57ab12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79b57ab12dfdd4e84536af7f227401f6fac24a60), [#6108](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6108)).

Blur draws in one of two ways. When every mover only slides, a cheap filter tier draws it. When anything turns or scales, it captures the frame instead ([79b57ab12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79b57ab12dfdd4e84536af7f227401f6fac24a60), [#6108](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6108)). Where capture cannot run, blur falls back to the filter tier rather than turning off ([4ed781338](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ed78133873540ca10366b1230d973dc31ae2ddf), [#6107](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6107)). `hyperframes check` says why blur is off when it is ([4371981b7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4371981b740d92f70e520cfbec34db68a1c93434), [#5992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5992)). Blur stays off for HDR and distributed renders. The [motion blur guide](/guides/motion-blur) covers the attributes and tiers ([4a788583f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4a788583f6ffd311c0093494815faa5f08c498bd), [#6049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6049)).

## The browser editor

Studio exports GIFs with a loop count, at up to 30 fps ([2d695a843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2d695a8436e27a9bba0a989eb83e41efeb779e7c), [#5593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5593)). The preview has a seek bar ([2512642d0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2512642d09d3d5a4703fd2e6af71930a52e6c7ca), [#6103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6103)). The timeline can zoom to fit the selected clips ([d787681d1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d787681d12e89f8adc8123e66ab9dfa37e8dc86f), [#5824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5824)).

Heavy videos play from lighter preview copies below full quality ([38d9aeb5e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/38d9aeb5ea1fa47a09d53c2db6df8079986b8a43), [#6365](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6365)). The preview shows how far each copy has got, retries a failed one, and remembers the quality you picked on that computer ([84fd701da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84fd701daaac9593e6b4a5b94116b6cc039a154a), [#6366](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6366)). Studio loads GSAP from the copy the CLI ships instead of jsDelivr ([7f19f2335](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f19f2335a11e72340c5ac0d99d17d656c71c34f), [#6256](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6256)). An idle editor no longer wakes the GPU four times a second ([6ad7c82d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6ad7c82d2175d018a93a85e96883dc31231b9884), [#6109](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6109)).

## A smooth preview on long films

The preview mounts and draws only the scenes near the playhead ([70187a13b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70187a13b59118cf056f3bcdcd0c0df8f453a9f8), [#6189](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6189)). A film opens and seeks without styling every hidden scene first ([6bc0b68be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6bc0b68be09de915d72571bc30f8c1b4709b3c7c), [#6356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6356)). The preview fetches only the clips due next and drops clips it has already passed ([179098936](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/179098936faaa21fd2bf74dfa80b4e705fdb3c65), [#6160](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6160)). Scrubbing a long film stays smooth ([dc56b3d20](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc56b3d20af2dbb550ac749b7618ea976542e257), [#6416](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6416)). Audio fades play as ramps on the audio clock, so cuts no longer click ([07a126d80](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/07a126d80fd6c0077dcce1c0a063709a1f9d1b75), [#6397](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6397)).

## Lambda on arm64

`hyperframes lambda deploy` now renders chunks on arm64 by default. Pass `--video-arch x86_64` to keep x86 ([504ec2b30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/504ec2b307625f790a633184355c07aa3381b8f6), [#6073](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6073)). Deploy works from the npm install, with no repo checkout ([b501dc4e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b501dc4e1b4c2e4273c6834c45024fb4115efc05), [#5866](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5866)), and pushes the prebuilt image without Docker ([0df088926](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0df088926ef94fd42ff772a9990bd3d9f240749d), [#6063](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6063)). It also warms the video function, so the first render does not wait for its image ([a11280eef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a11280eef09305ed6517ca6c08bdc5929f38a5a2), [#6376](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6376)). `lambda render --width 3840 --height 2160` on a 1920 by 1080 composition now renders in 4K. Before, it rendered at 1080p and printed a warning ([8d773fc68](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d773fc68a146b6b2caecce61f6d904d3a46454d), [#6390](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6390)).

## Cloud renders

`hyperframes cloud render` uploads media of 5 MB or more as HeyGen assets instead of packing it in the project zip ([b306438e8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b306438e8b5e2199db1ed07e6eb4332d53131048), [#5931](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5931)). 4K renders work for transparent MOV and WebM ([25126bca6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/25126bca6ced6cb8c839213430cde51e48261b7c), [#6045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6045)). A cloud render plans without reading video bytes and starts its chunks sooner ([da4386f0d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da4386f0d06955cbdd09bce5a6e837f4c657654f), [#6194](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6194)). It mixes its audio beside the chunks ([dee8380d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dee8380d2295070353aac1f98deb28c030d86572), [#5997](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5997)) and cuts each chunk by its estimated capture cost ([aae32e43e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aae32e43eddb39c5ac698e4ed0dc98e175c9dd26), [#6295](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6295)).

A render request can carry a time budget, `maxRenderMs`. A render that clearly cannot finish inside it stops early and says why ([7f5d6ed20](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f5d6ed2036f83cb2d3048e1150909a29d9b43ce), [#6224](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6224)). A render whose capture stops advancing fails within minutes ([575f68cf5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/575f68cf5bc4789e0f2b71c16333f5ef79586156), [#6413](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6413)).

## Faster local renders

On a Mac, video frames decode on the media engine through VideoToolbox, with byte-identical output ([e51ec11ca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e51ec11caa457a11dcad4c1f11135e4df781c229), [#5878](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5878)). Multi-worker MP4 renders start encoding while frames are still being captured, when a core is spare ([eec3c51d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eec3c51d7509365c388b4a962a7156cbb52ae62a), [#5952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5952)). VP9 and VP8 sources without alpha extract as JPEG ([382a14d73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/382a14d73e7ab5b77f2c118a012338364c4373b8), [#6284](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6284)). H.265 renders no longer fail on hosts with more than 16 cores ([53e1dfce9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53e1dfce9e6afbf1fcac26ea4adf27a66039b837), [#6193](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6193)), and any number of audio clips can be mixed ([3cdae3804](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3cdae3804e5f155903adfce32ddf81db290c04b3), [#6120](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6120)).

## Check and the CLI

CLI commands start sooner. Heavy packages load only when a command needs them ([5583ae429](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5583ae4293c64f21f09de7b820920963b9d51e3c), [#5930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5930)), and registry schemas compile on first use ([d898ad89e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d898ad89eef52e12ebd4fd90f03c1cdb53ba143c), [#5935](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5935)). A repeat `check` starts with the CLI and Chrome already up ([434ad8c41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/434ad8c41c6fd86b4341c52cc6e751f40474f13f), [#5943](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5943)), and check splits its samples over a second Chrome when a core and memory are spare ([952c6ba1c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/952c6ba1c5cdef9411a7daad2b550e63010661c2), [#5896](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5896)).

`check` finishes on long projects with many video clips ([37f5f2729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/37f5f272908d9bb0e596e902f4a45e81fc7a73b0), [#6270](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6270)). `check --prepare-media` makes the video copies and exits ([841195653](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84119565344493e005c23c9fe29c3571a463143d), [#6104](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6104)). A check stopped by a signal prints the report it has so far ([1f740ca21](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f740ca21a4ab2e90116ecfcc553e87ed7241062), [#6282](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6282)), and one that hits its deadline keeps the findings it already made ([ebb057fb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ebb057fb62f10e97a2d89f70eab9840394b074cf), [#6190](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6190)). New lint rules flag CSS that selects on the inline style attribute ([e003815c3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e003815c3073ed83907c620a37d64d1dc68ceb48), [#6261](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6261)) and scene styles that sit outside the scene's template ([ad6771c43](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ad6771c435e6fb57c540f630820d2a1265c0c63d), [#6317](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6317)).

`hyperframes <dir>` opens that project in the desktop app ([324671829](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/324671829f40f719b445290594597086e1cd7798), [#6426](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6426)). `hyperframes audio <file> --read` turns a recording into time-stamped lines of voice, sound effects and music that an agent can read ([2c1d9d50d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c1d9d50d239d48862578f574c25de216be02746), [#6056](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6056)).

## Skills and docs

The published skills go from 21 to 7. The domain skills fold into guides inside `hyperframes` and `media-use`, and the workflow skills retire ([688229314](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/688229314fb219c4317351c25483ecc3c56a519b), [#5651](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5651)). `init` never touches installed skills, and no command removes one ([0d104e6fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0d104e6fca496f7d8659c9266813fc6750294635), [#6168](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6168)).

Every CLI command is documented, and CI checks that it stays that way ([1b1a576d5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1b1a576d52bcb0bdcef5de67a37024f2224d1a53), [#5938](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5938)). The docs gained one Troubleshooting page ([a988afa00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a988afa00bc5dd391dbabb82adebc795ece8d730), [#6380](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6380)), an FAQ ([a183125e9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a183125e97e176af628ed36826758332ad8e9d6d), [#6382](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6382)), and an Inspiration page with films and remixes to start from ([3f1950b80](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3f1950b806e72fece41552077b491f1c8c6e8b28), [#6383](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6383)). New guides cover making videos with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor ([5bb9431a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5bb9431a987f5b72b2f0a0a2e88763dfd20db904), [#6352](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6352)). The Studio app installs on Linux from a .deb ([29643c7c8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29643c7c8a3a4085f08f895d56c4b7cc072f2d69), [#5946](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5946)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

**Week of October 12, 2026**

Weekly digest - October 12, 2026 - October 19, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Oct12 19" />

This week was about agents and long films. Agents can now inspect a composition before they edit it, check or snapshot only the part they touched, and measure where sounds land. Renders go down to 720p and 480p, long cloud renders finish faster, and the preview keeps its frame rate deep into long films. v0.8.151 through v0.8.176 shipped.

## Tools for agents that edit compositions

`@hyperframes/inspector` is a new package that answers which HTML, CSS and GSAP source belongs to an element ([73bbd378d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73bbd378df6cce37cc8885585018b3055ead8f22), [#5507](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5507)). It can query an element's animation schedule and inspect a running preview ([f45788bb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f45788bb6d3b4a8d51391b841c815ac6444d2f34), [#5508](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5508)), and it runs under Node as well as Bun ([072f53cda](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/072f53cda9bb648ef0f4e00836825352e6619d39), [#5509](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5509)). It is now published to npm ([f31b3c982](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f31b3c982be997897ba989c9975c9b44fe491fda), [#5530](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5530)). The package no longer ships predefined agent tools, so each harness defines its own over the same HTTP contract ([abe97f6e4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/abe97f6e4c704d745dccc4012e7adb2644624c5e), [#5570](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5570)).

`hyperframes check` can check only a time range with `--range` or report only on chosen elements with `--components` ([36526bf1a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36526bf1a65806af7d8670d974882faef65e61e7), [#5516](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5516)). `hyperframes snapshot` takes the same `--range`, or `--composition` to cover one scene ([1cd086f7e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1cd086f7e3675c992492714250a09cd36989a5c6), [#5519](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5519)). `snapshot --keep` redoes one still and leaves the others in place ([c0636d017](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c0636d017f68073522ab8eeb6cc24a2d3993b656), [#5605](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5605)).

Check reports and snapshots are saved under `.hyperframes/artifacts/` against the revision they were made from ([23d1fe5b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/23d1fe5b42724a5a9c0458475176d6bddfa235b1), [#5522](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5522)). Project history keeps `.hyperframes/video-state.json` up to date and records which element each edit targeted ([893b4f675](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/893b4f6757f4d6e8c6a1deb9d2c4743119694b46), [#5524](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5524)). History turns take `--exclusive`, `--who` and `--if-open`, so two agents in one project no longer end each other's turns ([7c73b3cae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7c73b3caeebc2fd8db2f161f25d4f476ac2f78e2), [#5518](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5518)). A harness can set `HF_TOOL_CONTEXT` to receive artifact events and a project lock from `check` and `snapshot` ([1b60a40ef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1b60a40eff5475218a437a135b19b031abd00db9), [#5520](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5520)).

## Sounds in film time

`hyperframes audio` reports where a sound lands in the film: its onset, peak, hits and tail ([bb49858b8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb49858b8a4df6ae259e30cb2ce06bc77f86bbc5), [#5602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5602)). It also answers beats, downbeats, BPM and sections, each from the first provider that can answer ([8e340d220](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8e340d220ea40c994eb3b5cf69ae503eed267fe7), [#5632](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5632)). `hyperframes beats` no longer starts Chrome, and it runs the same beat tracker as Studio ([1544b519a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1544b519a944c595a8c1e7de071331754405a015), [#5634](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5634)). That tracker gives the same answer at any sample rate and follows chord changes ([695110e46](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/695110e46ba4ec971f5dcfc797ce8bf750e1029d), [#5644](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5644)).

Sound effects now come from Openverse, with the bundled library as the offline fallback ([49671b73d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/49671b73dd417f7fe0f3c3f500290df18b447cd0), [#5753](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5753)).

## Render at smaller sizes

`hyperframes render --resolution 720p` or `480p` renders a smaller file from a larger composition. Before, any preset smaller than the composition was refused ([09c0307c3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09c0307c3fd0318a7ea77e6b41df4e5d30a1902b), [#5724](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5724)). Distributed renders on Lambda and Cloud Run accept 25 fps ([cc9e1bb33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cc9e1bb33a430b878af6dcb257ce5c9a70f9f180), [#5423](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5423)). Studio's render route accepts `crf`, `videoBitrate`, `videoFrameFormat` and `hdrMode` ([ab8a4da53](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab8a4da53f31653350632980fa63cb07e957f0f6), [#5549](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5549)), and so does the producer's render server ([5de2712ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5de2712ad587ae3fe06e4087e30650fdbe34c909), [#5550](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5550)).

## Long cloud renders finish

Distributed renders size their chunks to the worker time limit and the available concurrency, instead of a fixed 16 chunks ([c69fd2c6e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c69fd2c6ecadedff88cdc09d37854a658bffb733), [#5765](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5765)). Color-graded video is priced by its real cost, so those chunks finish inside the limit too ([6c3cc7cbe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c3cc7cbe91bd194832f6613172b7123db9e5577), [#5883](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5883)). On Lambda, chunking follows the account's concurrency limits ([2a14cbc92](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a14cbc924ab6bd08b1e5ee97eadb5da3374acff), [#5813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5813)).

The plan step overlaps its audio work with hashing and uploads ([fb17f4119](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb17f41196200af9d7b9ab32a9439ceef0be15cc), [#5777](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5777)), and renders over two minutes encode their audio on several cores ([8e4ce7411](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8e4ce741182501271f415972d4a54156e004e3f8), [#5788](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5788)). Assembly runs in one pass and keeps disk use under one copy of the output ([a498cf203](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a498cf2032c6b22492dedb475ad6196a8d6c6797), [#5768](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5768)). Renders embed local fonts as they are instead of recompressing them ([2b57809d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b57809d79176b34ce60f4206361e99fac618ccf), [#5865](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5865)).

`hyperframes cloud render` downloads the finished video over parallel connections and notices a finished render within 2 seconds ([cddb34fea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cddb34feacf50f9637bf84893b5bd36a140385c9), [#5864](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5864)). A download part that loses its connection resumes from where it stopped ([cea0bad79](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea0bad7931122bd93680006978c0d9007daa3d4), [#5873](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5873)).

## A smooth preview on long films

The preview runtime scales with what plays, not with the number of clips in the film ([d05bc4215](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d05bc4215d5757da86956217f4a8a4b2ab11b1fd), [#5674](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5674)). Playback and jumps do only the work on screen ([959dd3e58](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/959dd3e584cc22ab9004926735ab9c3effc6d0cc), [#5754](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5754)). Scenes stop animating after their clip ends ([c4440dfb2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4440dfb200def5e0c0afee938778f05b5985039), [#5741](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5741)), and a clip in a later scene waits to load until it is due ([13ea83495](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13ea8349597bbcb874402d1771aea65766fd7ffc), [#5716](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5716)). Every graded clip draws through one WebGL context ([aba5eae23](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aba5eae230015e96dfa964030a9333fdc098de78), [#5809](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5809)), and each web font loads once instead of once per scene ([80667726e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80667726e8a94257e372a2361b0705f3f788c5ad), [#5806](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5806)). Composition scripts no longer block the page in one long task ([12d8df37f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12d8df37f4db8ccf019da32c97cc1352f8db9652), [#5713](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5713)).

The transport keeps ticking in a hidden tab ([b168d0b41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b168d0b4138cb578c07f21e12441c8302a217308), [#5872](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5872)). Scrubbing back across a scene no longer leaves it hidden ([4cf0e3a0e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4cf0e3a0e599c73a9a96efcee8f62099323a08cf), [#5766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5766)), and a caption line shows again after the playhead jumps back over it ([4e6fcdb3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4e6fcdb3a9f310a9c483622d6a4ca5354a63fb22), [#5690](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5690)). Scenes stop resetting during playback when the root has no animation of its own ([19a8d44b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19a8d44b480d0b602c7fa06abca656cd2b13d803), [#5693](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5693)). A composition mounted twice keeps each mount's own timeline ([c38e9f350](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c38e9f350b4dbe6b09a6a35d5db0d437b9464220), [#5729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5729)).

## Color and frames in exports

Exports carry full color tags with every encoder, SDR and HDR ([ea742c501](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea742c501880cdcce141d8c10ea711a0e3ff7208), [#5742](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5742)). ProRes MOV output is encoded and tagged as BT.709 ([c8e105dc9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8e105dc9281d29ccd667a72f3cc9f970b1b862f), [#5382](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5382)). In HLG exports, white text sits at reference white instead of peak ([d796846d8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d796846d83fe6e65efef0e8bc179d2726d506417), [#5749](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5749)). SDR MP4s keep their rightmost 8 columns at widths like 1080 ([401354cd8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/401354cd8f685d9ec9011b41d2c4269289d29598), [#5559](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5559)).

Graded footage no longer picks up color noise from JPEG frame capture ([f073281bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f073281bd9e81b24d86c646feb863504e4d685f0), [#5514](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5514)), and a graded video keeps its grade on its first rendered frame ([95837a3df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/95837a3df7c10199a83fa1bd6ff92eafc2d1e750), [#5575](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5575)). Color grading now works on `<canvas>` ([5658f7006](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5658f700650bb10c000229da9374df02b2f6b5ee), [#5860](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5860)). A 29.97 fps camera clip exports smoothly at 30 fps ([b46ebedea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b46ebedeae959d3060ca4ece244ea6861d0f2352), [#5849](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5849)), and variable frame rate video no longer freezes on FFmpeg 8 ([6afcb4839](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6afcb48395632b85663b9b9486e1b47fd175f8bc), [#5572](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5572)).

Cards that fly in stay on screen in exported scenes ([fff3636fe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fff3636fe727512af54c876982c73050ca2c8fa5), [#5692](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5692)), and a scene shows its starting state on the first frame ([8c00ebad8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c00ebad80c634f607e3a5283f8a0aa73e35f1dd), [#5614](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5614)). Local renders size width-only videos the way the browser does ([fc41fa277](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fc41fa277a5649eb4879b524192dd6bee39d7465), [#5771](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5771)).

## Agent sandboxes, Windows and WSL

Chrome starts inside an agent's macOS sandbox ([5e7ba0be9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5e7ba0be944b076d514fc082c25a0b7e35eeb42f), [#5781](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5781)). Inside it, `capture` works ([dc0e80e73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc0e80e73af185cc892ea90d5a9f1412a055e9a1), [#5840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5840)) and `check` no longer hangs ([834e90a77](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/834e90a779ee3b558cbcfef277e0ddb0fca02338), [#5836](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5836)). Render starts in a sandbox that forbids lowering CPU priority ([7e00f37be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7e00f37be2c76b4a9294c81aed79cf49667709f1), [#5814](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5814)), and check and snapshot run where a sandbox refuses to listen on localhost ([71595dd82](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/71595dd82012314f353d1237f50da0fad7639817), [#5618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5618)).

Under WSL, renders reach the GPU through full Chrome when the headless shell cannot ([9b996059a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9b996059af6530636b5a3eff9bdd2f52480f14d8), [#5574](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5574)), and on Chrome 150 and later ([38cfcdd56](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/38cfcdd56cdc1a8125a8e68a3604357a23ce819f), [#5591](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5591)). When a WSL render falls back to software, it says why ([96e2154d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/96e2154d7cd2eeadfe7287a7c0dadd50221df9c3), [#5560](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5560)). Multi-worker renders of media-heavy pages no longer hang on Windows and macOS ([102c14a6c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/102c14a6c4ce6bfd7850d9e2a01aac984c6883c2), [#5565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5565)). The first render on Windows no longer fails while a new browser or FFmpeg is scanned ([03a9fab9a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03a9fab9a7b1c8742198bca8f475d04a51feaf5e), [#5625](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5625)), and `init` works in a folder with a non-ASCII name ([d58d3edd3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d58d3edd39b05e7b4a3c7e90a78637471cd34c30), [#5833](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5833)).

## A faster, sharper check

`check` judges text behind a transparent video by the video's decoded alpha ([cea8aa8a7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea8aa8a7dee9d669e47e4b488213008bbe305cd), [#5657](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5657)). It warns when a tween ends just after a later tween on the same property ([69f330641](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/69f33064156a520cdb1c9d63d10bca1c40c75ae2), [#5521](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5521)). It finishes on video-heavy projects ([b1fbc16b6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b1fbc16b6cc2a40301409f04fd312cc7c2d6a417), [#5715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5715)) and on scenes with several Three.js canvases ([e9181d02f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e9181d02f5f446999528f6034733f416397cb6b1), [#5825](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5825)). Its overlap pass takes at most 240 samples ([caea3863b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/caea3863b075f5f79d1c77dd084d05ea05aa0529), [#5764](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5764)) and skips scenes the runtime hid ([066ca7e20](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/066ca7e20a1612e1f59cb019bc08caf8550d0090), [#5758](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5758)). Check and inspect skip paint waits and screenshots that nothing reads ([843494578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8434945784b5378358a1c661aa080e1894533578), [#5868](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5868)).

## Studio and the catalog

Studio's desktop-app button reads Install the desktop app and walks you through the download ([5975dd757](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5975dd7579bfaaeff3db2e1b94549a0bfe296ece), [#5854](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5854)). Splitting a video in an untimed wrapper cuts the video, not the wrapper ([aa9413b05](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa9413b05ebba83eb1c96f3ebdb707ba51cf1897), [#5486](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5486)). An edit aimed at a clip never lands on an audio group that shares its id ([49c49504a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/49c49504a44e0352f6877611f5384e7aedcc4e92), [#5645](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5645)). A failed preview reload says which step it was waiting for ([726664626](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72666462647c487542118a8fc3a40ceab734c80c), [#5700](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5700)).

The new `filmed-screen` component films a live scene the way a phone films a monitor ([071ce8044](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/071ce8044fd98736f80278e8c2645e97628430d0), [#5487](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5487)). It curves, orbits and follows typing by default ([3886aaec2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3886aaec28ae1ccf8ce3a0bd1bd48a084c353fa9), [#5499](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5499)).

## CLI

`init --keep-original` copies a clip as it is, without transcoding ([d65eefad5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d65eefad5ed351e9d36d2caeb6049878be0aba85), [#5612](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5612)). `timeline delete --start/--end` removes only that range ([d2b8ea764](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2b8ea764431d739d5dd3ffed1df74470fa01fae), [#5867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5867)). `timeline` lists clips nested in a timed element ([eab6ca15b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eab6ca15b1af7ec7bca0bbeb4cd0330e677467a5), [#5732](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5732)). A render that no FFmpeg encoder can finish stops before capture ([9fd5e4ae2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fd5e4ae2df6dbee3cb15e045435dc7dc077b340), [#5831](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5831)). `catalog` loads items a few at a time, so a slow link no longer times them out ([95a686c23](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/95a686c23d794ebd6af9eef713472f1cf3f6821a), [#5829](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5829)). Website capture connects only to public addresses ([8be76fc86](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8be76fc86cda5b2a77d0ee23b65f582e85376042), [#5668](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5668)).

The docs have a reference page for every lint finding code ([c3816a121](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3816a121b0dae08af2e3bf13df9d2fe225628bf), [#5493](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5493)). The CLI reference now covers `open`, `catch-up`, `timeline` and `history` ([2973b3c8e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2973b3c8e4464a2cd454d0909dd59c4277afd6f3), [#5442](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5442)).
