**Week of October 5, 2026**

Weekly digest - October 5, 2026 - October 12, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Oct05 12" />

Audio got a master bus this week, so one limiter can sit over the whole mix. Transcription writes a caption file in one step, and the terminal can catch up on what happened in the desktop app. Exports match the preview in more places, and the catalog gained 36 WebGPU shader backgrounds. v0.8.135 through v0.8.150 shipped.

## One effect chain over the whole mix

A `data-fx-chain` on the top-level composition root now runs once over the sum of every clip and every group, in the preview and in the export ([e1925d431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1925d4317fcd13c0e5799cd4767a3e2dd4c9238), [#5420](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5420)). Export reads the mix unclipped and encodes it last. A sub-composition root's chain still does nothing.

The new `truepeak` effect is a lookahead limiter that also catches the peaks between samples ([3746703ea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3746703ea77fa93eb9f8a8312058cf233b56776e), [#5419](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5419)). The old limiter could leave the true peak several dB over its ceiling. The truepeak ceiling is a 4x estimate, so the docs recommend a 2 dB margin under a hard delivery limit.

A scene rendered on its own uses its own master chain, and very long mixes render in 5 minute windows instead of hitting Node's 2 GiB file limit ([30359f803](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/30359f80382686da98f88cc1907c44d07ef82c09), [#5474](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5474)). The pitch shifter keeps its tail, and a bitcrush no longer plays silence after a seek ([8f7906b33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8f7906b337f8c74ef271101bff90363e6c6c93b4), [#5478](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5478)).

## Captions straight from a media file

`hyperframes transcribe --to srt` or `--to vtt` writes a caption file straight from a media file. It refuses an output path that would overwrite the media or its transcript ([908f4395b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/908f4395b4d05a3969bdc53a7cc89cea0d48e8ff), [#5215](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5215)). `hyperframes models list` shows which speech models transcribe can use ([0576b24c7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0576b24c75a604deb9c909407b8328b3df17b0c1), [#5323](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5323)).

Transcription reports its language and progress ([1db44c659](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1db44c659565a5a70a39fbe836c497afe9a84d6d), [#5103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5103)), and the `--json` progress stream carries words as they are heard ([156e87766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/156e87766c77c8b9c680b7dc107f94b4ee734f17), [#5127](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5127)). parakeet-mlx detects the language itself ([34552a21d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/34552a21d20e688cfa7a62925c53dee9a2634eff), [#5124](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5124)). Transcribe no longer drops words that come before the detected speech onset ([e21ab020d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e21ab020da17380987f4786f485cae96588292fb), [#5164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5164)). Built-in transcription runs inside Electron ([f7bba2288](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f7bba2288dfcbfbf0c93c8c63caee1893a442b9d), [#5129](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5129)).

WebVTT files that transcribe reads keep speaker labels ([7faff8154](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7faff8154f86892509f9997a45ef389f572fd3e7), [#5233](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5233)), literal cue text ([1fac5fb29](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1fac5fb29d1588aa2af4cc6f2307f110ac3218f0), [#5236](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5236)) and timestamps that come before cue settings ([f5aeecdbf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5aeecdbf4b43f11cd084984a754e8a433d1dba8), [#5224](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5224)). Subtitle cues survive any line ending ([9c1d3fbe6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9c1d3fbe622cb88702223bb5fdf443367f3ea90c), [#5223](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5223)).

## The terminal and the desktop app stay in step

`hyperframes catch-up` prints what happened in the desktop app since a project was handed over. It shows what the person asked, what Framey did and which files changed ([6fe3c2ce9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6fe3c2ce94f5d2e926cc7fcf79d3e62f4e68dac7), [#5114](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5114)). Any command on a project with unseen turns ends with a line that points to it, and Grok sessions can be handed over too. History reads answer while another app has the project open ([489036c84](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/489036c8439408f38cecafded273ddf5752b9162), [#5445](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5445)).

`hyperframes/api` exports `transcribe()` and `removeBackground()` as plain functions, so the desktop app can call them without running the CLI as a child process ([943b6512b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/943b6512b43b106c79839a977f3bfa4aa115a11d), [#5453](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5453)). Studio's file routes can no longer read or write the desktop app's hand-off file or chat history ([32516b5a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32516b5a3d7ad1845feaedaaea94334ca38b8853), [#5113](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5113)).

Inside a host app, the media skills reach HeyGen through the host's gateway ([21d14b25b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/21d14b25b3b3530da60ccbc9ad58788398b797c0), [#5181](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5181)) and use the host's music tools first ([4fcad1ed7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4fcad1ed74bd629b98f91ef53be8fdf154528924), [#5154](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5154)). The CLI accepts host-managed HeyGen access tokens ([cf1b04bb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cf1b04bb71662b20a236bb8d0e80499d541cae8f), [#5177](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5177)). A host can show Studio's hover box and give the stage its starting size ([1e711b087](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1e711b087dca254fa021f0c16006197c138d1884), [#5116](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5116)). Agents can send a missing feature or host app friction as feedback without a rating ([80c2547ea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80c2547eac05c345e5d3eab490940fd375452f61), [#5140](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5140)).

## Exports match the preview

A split scene plays its videos from its in-point in the preview and the timeline ([480807ec4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/480807ec4be4c28a6ac190f863354bf8d6b7d4c7), [#5413](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5413)), and the export now places them the same way ([2905162d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2905162d925fc87fb8242e24ed0bbf025d307ea1), [#5454](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5454)). `timeline split` keeps a scene's place in both halves ([165be8513](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/165be85132813b941987387d1cbaf870d1bd8653), [#5410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5410)). An element its own script hides stays hidden while the preview plays ([2fbaef6ab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2fbaef6abb5207b6f9ef3ba0d94320a6b082fc95), [#5458](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5458)).

MP4, MOV and TS exports keep sound and picture in sync when a source's audio and video streams start apart ([b211fc7cb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b211fc7cb845c6838cbdb1860506c2fda2804787), [#5455](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5455)). Motion blur works over video. The footage stays as shot and only the layers over it blur ([3b89bfe8a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3b89bfe8a71fb966c9fd7129935ada39d1fdb1d1), [#5150](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5150)). Renders keep a `fromTo` tween's from values from the frame it starts on ([755ab7d16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/755ab7d1657ff2c2b6e2bd712ffbfcab97a617f5), [#5125](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5125)). An export no longer fails on a video clip that sits outside the composition's length ([81f60dbc9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/81f60dbc9850110273a4d0df9cfb32803476f13a), [#5431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5431)).

## Long renders finish

Long exports with many clips no longer stall at 90% or hide a timeout ([4b68f73fe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4b68f73fe76b14934d38504b55735070807f5927), [#5375](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5375)). When Chrome hangs, the render names the step it hung in and says what to do ([bb34e301e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb34e301ec3c5f7b9edad07932356bd02a9f7934), [#5450](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5450)). The automatic worker count stays within what the JavaScript heap can feed, and an explicit `--workers` is unchanged ([9e0d05d45](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e0d05d450641a491ee9fc254a122671ba94a223), [#5149](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5149)). Renders report their encoding and assembling progress ([cffc3aa4e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cffc3aa4e1f888b4867e4b69f602d1c12dc58e32), [#5137](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5137)).

A re-render of a composition with a remote video reuses its extracted frames ([b6467d913](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b6467d91315e800f6dd62641c2d98e5b8a9e8801), [#5408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5408)). Studio's export can encode on the GPU like `render --gpu`. It is an MP4 option and stays off until you tick it ([91f9c9eb0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/91f9c9eb04619bfe5c43ccee1c87cad2f8a2f65a), [#5397](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5397)).

## 36 WebGPU shader backgrounds

The catalog gained 36 shader backgrounds from the Shaders library. Six arrived first, from godrays to liquid metal ([7cf042d74](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7cf042d74f8aa32e5eb625ce233bc8791e09e4c6), [#5138](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5138)). Then came eight ([63a7ec692](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63a7ec692f4a6bbdbcf39b68561fb197b233df32), [#5191](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5191)), eight more from blob to fractal noise ([46f6cb356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/46f6cb356785bed79e1ce7b79d7e7accc697786a), [#5192](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5192)), seven from ripples to thin film ([9dbbca745](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9dbbca7459d4951c14e46798166766eb5a84d010), [#5190](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5190)) and seven from sun burst to color wheel ([b05960008](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b0596000838d513200d64d6cad9ad0298d287785), [#5341](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5341)). They need WebGPU to render. `snapshot`, `check` and `layout` now handle WebGPU compositions the way `render` does ([f85614ecb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f85614ecb222e7ffedf61d6f16811fae6eae5427), [#5354](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5354)).

A gooey split block turns a dot into a three-dot menu through a gooey neck ([b50dead1d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b50dead1da595786c4de5772332885781b288791), [#5123](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5123)).

## Studio

The preview decodes HEVC and ProRes clips at the size they are shown instead of at full source size ([b66e8a195](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b66e8a195e5a08b5bdd654337973d50e08c1ea51), [#5184](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5184)). Small previews of heavy compositions no longer drop layers ([5562c280d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5562c280daaad390625496aaefaa701d552c0612), [#5268](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5268)). Slow clips stay on the playhead at reduced preview speeds ([7d958fea0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7d958fea0ba01c80a023e366adfe8cb2f3d14a17), [#5440](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5440)). The preview stops at the film's end when a scene loops forever ([cea48a548](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea48a548ab18c729ecb5314a0ed78a7507d5acd), [#5320](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5320)), and a stalled font or asset no longer leaves it empty ([d93b76976](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d93b7697635ca5327fbceb67325c578a70c5b7fc), [#5370](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5370)). It loads the next scene's images before that scene starts ([11e684d30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/11e684d3050f27c546425fdbff1d38a94fe3ecb7), [#5128](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5128)). Zooming a long timeline is smooth ([eee0c5101](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eee0c5101c00dcc1c6c5f02589ee52619611b837), [#5109](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5109)) and decodes only frames it has not seen ([9f09861d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9f09861d2e784965b532254a524ea2313db31470), [#5142](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5142)).

Undo takes back the last edit, even right after a resize or a nudge ([98fe01169](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98fe011699999901affa2f6aa558568d17dc9e1a), [#5048](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5048)). Keyframed animations keep their ease through every Studio edit ([0d5e395cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0d5e395cd31d0f491e9b26d0da110da6e231c512), [#5051](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5051)). Moving a clip to another row restacks only that clip ([ff8ad1ca2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff8ad1ca25ce0159b3ff00feb267a720ca8e45cd), [#5057](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5057)). Drags after a resize, undo or reload land where they were pressed ([dc244d765](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc244d765c3e825e12d06311ad6d4f09b77be3f3), [#5088](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5088)). File names with %, apostrophes or \$ no longer break Studio ([621ddd469](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/621ddd46934316fe81f1b6254e4ae57bc8ec5ada), [#5156](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5156)). An edit the history cannot record says why in the log ([86521b94f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86521b94f592bcf0ca86aba63068893cf658af16), [#5489](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5489)).

## CLI and Windows

On Windows, renders no longer cancel when an old parent's process id is reused ([ce359d91c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce359d91cb6c765c5eee26098ce482ec87581956), [#5358](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5358)). Skills mirror into every installed agent ([ce73339b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce73339b1a1407237b133ff9e9398ae282919eb9), [#5367](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5367)), and the audio duration probe reads to the end ([3d6de0581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3d6de0581ed9161fb8578222b3ec270413aebbab), [#5395](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5395)). The browser download unpacks on machines without an unzip command ([9e9b613cc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e9b613ccf867f98838617f7424967e056e63de2), [#5433](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5433)).

FFmpeg is found when a project's npm installer package provides it ([748cda906](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/748cda9069768ad5b1711379162fc22f1b1076a8), [#5434](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5434)) or when it is installed after a preview started ([64c47cf3d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/64c47cf3d1b00aa6dd76a3d40256f235654eacb1), [#5439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5439)). `preview --background` reports a preview that cannot start instead of waiting it out ([6c96ea534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c96ea5344341c1648ec5df565eff2c1ba070519), [#5437](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5437)). `check` warns instead of failing on a still title card ([b20f3f7ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b20f3f7ad956018cd18c6be0ac6c8ff9ddcf2a18), [#5369](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5369)), and warns when a video's browser-playable copy cannot be made ([bf7f6deae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf7f6deae932b4793065c74c20d9184f099fc386), [#5441](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5441)). `media-treatment` applies one treatment to every matched image or video ([44e5a47e0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/44e5a47e09a14f792126b4ec6a3d9f7b3b7c346e), [#5443](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5443)). The npm packages ship without source maps, and CI holds each one to a size budget ([bb9e507e8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb9e507e8408d7098aefc1b8bad418b5e8e12c92), [#5403](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5403)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

**Week of September 28, 2026**

Weekly digest - September 28, 2026 - October 5, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep28 Oct05" />

Studio became a real audio editor this week, and undo now shows the moment you press it. Studio also got a light theme, and the CLI can hand a project to the HyperFrames desktop app on macOS. v0.8.84 through v0.8.134 shipped.

## Hand a project to the desktop app

`hyperframes open` hands a project folder to the HyperFrames desktop app, and Studio's header has an Edit with Framey button that does the same ([bd0dc8c3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bd0dc8c3aeb08868f15a95631e5aab7790cce926), [#4951](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4951)). Hand-off works on macOS today and carries over the Claude Code or Codex conversation that started the project. Windows and Linux follow once the app can take a folder from the command line ([6a27a34f2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6a27a34f21ef178d3c5189ab8a4a9f6709c528da), [#4999](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4999)). The button now stands out in the header ([2b82e39cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b82e39cd6fde19a74ce4855d5bfc05ceb42b864), [#5019](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5019)).

Agent skills open Studio before every final render ([69a2169bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/69a2169bde0c134f42979e1911755084b1c29962), [#4952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4952)). The docs have Studio app pages for Mac and Linux ([061a5c026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/061a5c0265202538352a9888518064ae4fbb191c), [#5063](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5063)), and the README links Studio first ([60575dc0d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60575dc0d1f822151fbe620476acfbf21c654cab), [#4975](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4975)).

## Studio edits audio

An eight-part series turned the timeline into an audio editor. A video keeps its own sound on its clip by default ([37f30b1d0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/37f30b1d06c41b4ef4579e456bfe6c6aeaaa0611), [#4813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4813)). Videos with sound join audio groups, meters and carve in the preview ([3c299acc7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3c299acc7f6fd7f9802e808c41a34d8593473549), [#4814](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4814)). Studio can normalize a clip to -16 LUFS and duck music under a voice, with a limiter report ([9244c4732](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9244c47328e41e59034bd9bbec293fe3f7310cf6), [#4816](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4816)). Video clips with sound draw a waveform strip, and a CLIP light on the master meter latches when the mix hits the export ceiling ([824e4100c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/824e4100c636d30ac7c3036d9f5276c50e31eea4), [#4817](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4817)).

`data-link` ties a video to its audio, so the two select, drag, trim and split together ([0559be0b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0559be0b1398fc5240746e8668a9cf6d3bf1a5c1), [#4818](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4818)). Linked clips that drift out of sync can be repaired, and the clip menu is grouped into time, sound and picture ([45b8e171e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45b8e171e2792c89cc63b4d136de41eae6194b25), [#4820](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4820)). That menu adds speed presets, voice, look, crop presets and freeze frame ([000ccd426](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/000ccd426a3ecf700eff6f449e9f5eab42d393fd), [#4815](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4815)). Press G for an audio gain dialog, and clip names show their speed ([70900216f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70900216f0dab460fc16256b0d43a973fd5e519b), [#4821](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4821)).

The details got tighter too. Fade handles ride the fade's end, and the waveform shows the fade ([07af05c81](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/07af05c8169dd77c23d7129231330d5662059fa2), [#4844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4844)). A sound effect starts on its time instead of a frame late ([e0b940aa3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e0b940aa302efb011009395af54d4023ae08baf1), [#4696](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4696)). Music keeps playing smoothly across video cuts ([b3c520782](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b3c52078272d54a3e3c411391dc5cc5ad270c2d9), [#4939](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4939)), and a boosted video plays at its boosted volume ([2fc5a37fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2fc5a37fcebaaa1ed9b2dd7f2f6dd4b2983efe30), [#4746](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4746)). An unmuted track can be muted again ([98763899d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98763899d6ae1c7929ade1bb30f9cdf6c86fd0fd), [#4977](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4977)). Audio edits that rewrite a file save that content again, and a failed write reports as failed ([76c4fc7b3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/76c4fc7b3cf172d9e2a953a41e80004838f235a9), [#4887](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4887)).

## Undo shows at once

Undo and redo show on the next frame instead of after the server answers ([6ba35c9e3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6ba35c9e3b7d8859c2567fca5f4cfc3d4cc43fe7), [#4798](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4798)). They update the preview in place instead of reloading it ([9e1dbca7a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e1dbca7a2c2ea7486852efe737b606f86dd4e32), [#4718](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4718)). Undo right after an edit takes back that edit, even before its save lands ([c3b6e55f7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3b6e55f7eb6eea845dc001889b50fc35b841d4e), [#4807](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4807)). A move or nudge paints back at once while its save runs ([880b4c41b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/880b4c41b3c5708bd9a4317dab687c082219d3d6), [#4877](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4877)), and so does a resize, rotate or GSAP edit ([49333a882](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/49333a882d343cef768f16739a84643296e9da5d), [#5022](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5022)). Undo no longer waits behind thumbnail renders ([d0404b450](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d0404b450cb6f1f0392bbd458ff87131b2bc8cea), [#4842](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4842)), and one Cmd+Z in the preview takes one step, not three ([f2ef034fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f2ef034fabedef79ae7f312703a8bb490de5af4a), [#4824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4824)).

Undo also reaches further. Undoing an agent's build takes its sections off the timeline ([ae8d1780f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ae8d1780ff70bc1a5207cff46bbd9ce3395243f9), [#4757](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4757)). Undoing a freeze frame removes the still it made ([237a984bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/237a984bb8d97f8dff7a5464c78851d633747f54), [#4971](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4971)), and undo takes the media ledger back with the film ([a2f416089](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a2f41608993e3fa74b81b5845d3000a7a0be698e), [#5016](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5016)). The first edit of a film whose media is still being copied can be undone ([c6478e404](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6478e404c668c848717555fe134562b11804a9c), [#5043](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5043)).

## Canvas edits land where you let go

An element without GSAP moves and nudges by its own CSS translate ([c8f848f98](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8f848f98482362efcba337ceb35b240f89e1d7f), [#4799](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4799)) and resizes by its own width and height ([3e011b7e5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e011b7e5f4dca52c4558dacea45ad4e213a3b5f), [#4805](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4805)). A rotation saves where you let go ([74f501321](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/74f5013210e382ed9f7867e1636abf80975a55ed), [#4802](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4802)). Drags keep sub-pixel position and angle ([ca3a3f6e0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ca3a3f6e0b37c993ec25a5280bd74fbfc828c0db), [#4766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4766)). Edits on GSAP-animated layers keep their keyframes ([d4756f597](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4756f597c0dbb66310c2add699de6767b23f11b), [#4869](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4869)), and plain elements keep their place and size when keyframed ([5c7f11ab6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c7f11ab6d8a881eb3b6ddaa5905fa8d6af9db44), [#5045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5045)). Moving one word moves only that word ([5606b3102](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5606b31020e14bcab3a031fc6db561441c980149), [#4705](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4705)).

Handles behave as you expect. A corner drag on a small element resizes it instead of starting a crop ([3e4ccd956](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e4ccd956700ba11f4490247fa0a84c77c493ee7), [#4730](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4730)). Resizing a cropped element keeps the same part of it in view ([76c634dfa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/76c634dfa5f9d0119342e0eda80325aee518dff4), [#4743](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4743)). Shift+drag moves a selection along one axis ([3f8b46cc1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3f8b46cc1e0bc768940d49f3b1ce8eba1fca32e0), [#4747](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4747)).

Editing is lighter on the machine. Manual edits stay under 8 ms of work per frame ([438ea9d59](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/438ea9d59fd5c1e720cc55311150dd3b25fab3db), [#4898](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4898)). An edited scene swaps into the live preview instead of reloading the whole film ([303c8e922](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/303c8e922f89f657557ad304557101e36fbd7750), [#4499](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4499)). Clicking an element selects it without restyling the whole film ([1bede4742](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1bede4742a502cf8f6dfaccfafa3f7ef01f12299), [#4707](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4707)). A new edit accuracy benchmark ([0c6f5fd80](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c6f5fd80edcdf8286d463c4f3dc886ac0d07e70), [#4760](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4760)) now gates manual editing in CI ([097250e11](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/097250e11c0d891e201399016f79c484043aa800), [#4765](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4765)).

## Timeline

One tool picker holds Select, Split, Select leftward and Select rightward ([6b59004de](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b59004de2dd233ce32ae2cb0743b3867c154d41), [#4714](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4714)). You can drag and resize any number of selected clips, saved in one write per file ([cd82ce044](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd82ce044d9fc48c340100fe58585f398658717d), [#4937](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4937)). A drop between tracks previews the new track ([67dbcf7bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/67dbcf7bdbe68eb4ad7a710676272552813955a8), [#4907](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4907)), and the empty lane below the last track is a drop target ([c3f7066bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3f7066bf33f9b5b826d5de933a414ddc59bd6df), [#4741](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4741)). Paste and duplicate can keep a clip at its own time ([ce76be50c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce76be50c7d90e3d91575b8de1e388af9ebc4adc), [#4859](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4859)). Trimming keeps the playhead still, and clips snap to the ruler grid ([7859c0f00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7859c0f0037a1e07988e6f5fba31a2c8bc6f9456), [#4986](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4986)). Clips get a Filmstrip name band ([0b1f5979f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b1f5979fd1458686da51705cb9832c45c5f946e), [#4897](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4897)), and long clips mount only the picture tiles in view ([1bdb5edd9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1bdb5edd93bb7fe58cbb5ec81133a23deb075ad2), [#4993](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4993)).

Nested compositions are steadier. You can enter a sub-composition from the keyboard ([af7ff3b0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/af7ff3b0a10433b07fd383804ee3b860a48b0bc5), [#4672](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4672)). Clips inside nested compositions sit at their master time ([3dc3a9ca1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3dc3a9ca1a48d6937f5e47e11c44c40b3b2f0ac2), [#4681](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4681)). Moving a clip moves its inner animations too ([f1c1f1d69](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f1c1f1d69cfe3a6b1c2d80bc88043e26fd52b907), [#4761](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4761)), and splitting a clip keeps keyframes the parser cannot read ([8c7672f10](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c7672f105a90a684cee44caf4ebb5340730ae2f), [#5044](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5044)).

## A light theme

Studio has a new Graphite colour system with a light theme. Every text role passes 4.5:1 contrast in both themes ([658f22bb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/658f22bb7f5d1cb3a5d8115c4cd316ff2a5a711f), [#4836](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4836)). A sun and moon button in the header switches themes and remembers the choice ([9f4d9e64b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9f4d9e64b228c29833da478d6c8c50f2549179c1), [#4839](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4839)). The code editor follows the theme ([e666a8a2a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e666a8a2a37ea77e4774f50ca832cd5766ba6fec), [#4862](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4862)).

## More of Studio for host apps

A host app can mount the Layers panel ([618fd7684](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/618fd7684b3c53a0e6a589e96b78602c1b46d44e), [#5049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5049)) and the dock with its own panels ([7719f973c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7719f973c059f4f54ef804b32a0e5746ff6c9a2f), [#4812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4812)). It can hold playback so nothing starts while it is held ([6bb85af18](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6bb85af18beef662aa6616fc2c598ba3414ef5a0), [#5060](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5060)). It can make the timeline read-only while seek, scroll and zoom stay live ([ae914334f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ae914334f279ee53b3aebd0437ef7a9c4d20f8b0), [#4749](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4749)), and add its own items to the clip right-click menu ([5b79038ca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5b79038ca4b2213f0089ec43404dc5927ec0d561), [#4784](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4784)).

Hosts can save canvas moves, resizes and rotations with Studio's handles ([001d001c5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/001d001c589f43d47076219cc4ac6a1c71a9d7bf), [#4709](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4709)) and save style edits through Studio's style commit ([0af671c6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0af671c6df8f8f740f2e982247ae3eab67dd0514), [#4698](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4698)). They can run Studio's agent tools on their own edit session ([7a60b97bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a60b97bf8c2bb6a6f90956316eef8fd0de5060f), [#4882](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4882)) and claim their writes under the key Studio's edit history uses ([72d4cc3ef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72d4cc3ef4edd062ff97df499439f7ae8eb05e20), [#5064](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5064)).

## Player and runtime

The player can play and loop part of a film with `range-start` and `range-end` ([840f65702](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/840f657028b9cf7f20a1a2efb9d436e52aa42d71), [#4688](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4688)). It also plays video files given as `type="video/..."` ([326bd0c9a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/326bd0c9a198f00769f8e0b64f51b1d1125f335f), [#4673](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4673)). The preview loads only the media near the playhead ([5a77dbcea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a77dbcea12bcc11f8480b2fc1242afca16e4135), [#4682](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4682)).

Composition scripts now start after web fonts are ready, so the same film renders the same way every time ([44b583625](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/44b5836250953fd34fa1d85b4843db34efd2232c), [#4980](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4980)). Bundled scripts keep their own place, defer and async ([16871a179](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/16871a1796876cf3f263081d85cec647cb7b6eeb), [#5014](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5014)). GSAP seeks are exact. A seek onto a tween's start shows that tween ([b7343e3a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b7343e3a95791bdc3448eddd6f00b4e73128b345), [#4942](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4942)). Set steps render on the frame they land on ([02775c716](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/02775c716fe7de72a7e384823373f9e7a8040c16), [#4911](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4911)), and a call added after the first seek fires once ([afe020ae5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/afe020ae59fb27bbbf1e90f8bddc634c4f2c0d81), [#4948](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4948)). The renderer's font pipeline is importable from `@hyperframes/core/fonts/embed` ([b3d2b82fe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b3d2b82fe95542af84a856e3d6f4ac7b333b044b), [#5041](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5041)).

## Renders

A render now fails when an injected video frame cannot decode ([8e457d422](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8e457d4224c513a8cdcb11b7d63aa204f5af7e0c), [#4974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4974)). An interrupted render leaves no captured frames behind ([f7ef18dca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f7ef18dca80c791a2991a90280638b32c109d227), [#4694](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4694)). Distributed renders keep a clip's playback rate ([3631ee3da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3631ee3da0e7cd3ca7e3047dbb13a55c4f638276), [#4736](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4736)). Alpha exports keep the composition root background ([d7285e414](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d7285e414b36c89ba2bdf248966bd8388db25862), [#3976](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3976)), and the engine warns when a video declares alpha but decodes opaque ([cad7dbed0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cad7dbed0dc29d53ec3a4bbb2b0bea2fa3c1495e), [#3771](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3771)). A bundled film inlines each shared font once instead of once per composition ([5df0bea8e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5df0bea8e1b0ebac4a3c8cfcafd349bbd1c9b336), [#4643](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4643)).

## CLI, agents and media

`hyperframes clean` finds and removes leftover render folders, debug renders, old history and video caches ([663b02297](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/663b02297d58b56d7153bb156451ebb2b830941b), [#4701](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4701)). `hyperframes usage` reports how much Claude Code, Codex or Grok subscription allowance is left, so an agent can plan a video around it ([734893311](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73489331114b89f42b5bc843765e610525188bcb), [#4919](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4919)). The CLI loads each command's code only when that command runs ([e07ea1fc7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e07ea1fc70335c6898c7fd1abaa31145c79c287a), [#4656](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4656)). Every command rejects extra positional arguments ([4178a8f95](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4178a8f95d3d3439ddde6b5d20a317ef01c97d61), [#4905](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4905)). SIGTERM and SIGINT close every browser the CLI launched ([8c81efb7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c81efb7c2d78727114cd2cddc2cf87929ace312), [#4910](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4910)), and `browser --force` no longer deletes Chrome under running renders ([f16e50983](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f16e509832d4fa02bbc9a5f81b59ff78f9d466af), [#4901](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4901)). Feedback says whether a person or an agent wrote it ([0ca69472d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ca69472d93cf088c836bed3dc7df252247e2101), [#4984](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4984)).

The media skills can clone, list and delete HeyGen voices, and accept a host OAuth token ([2497402b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2497402b270a4f613cf57abc1c29cbc260fb8c07), [#4992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4992)). They never replace a voice, music or sound file you put in the project ([2195db5e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2195db5e1d05f72d966e880e4d258a2e779fa143), [#4665](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4665)), and TTS speed now reaches Kokoro ([835e0c16e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/835e0c16ec62681008682934c4751e630d9d5d7b), [#4930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4930)).

Lint flags seek-unsafe CSS transitions ([f2eb6d9cc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f2eb6d9cc14004fd02f9997a8916f0ceae4e6529), [#3797](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3797)), and a missing image, audio or mask file names the composition that uses it ([7eb00137a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7eb00137a22e27a8a746ce0a788ac4ad6981613c), [#4616](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4616)). The layout check flags text that a clipping card cuts off ([09ab947e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09ab947e1ad0c00cad75515481d7742a2cf6e405), [#4577](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4577)).

## New in the catalog

The catalog adds 3D objects such as a product turntable, eight cursor animations, snow, a starfield, and paper and curtain transitions ([590c19249](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/590c192498ed738941380da7b3a2f6211966ba94), [#4349](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4349)). Four community components arrived, including a cinemagraph and a pendulum swing ([04acbb4d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04acbb4d9eaac198421ba1ef007dc3ce6a72ef9c), [#4906](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4906)). Eight ad templates show their video preview in the catalog ([d2398d686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2398d686a7fa45b7789e8ad273e64610607b062), [#4979](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4979)).

**Week of September 21, 2026**

Weekly digest - September 21, 2026 - September 28, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep21 28" />

Every change to a project is now recorded, and undo can reach any of it. Studio kept splitting into parts other apps can host, and the preview got much faster to open and cheaper to leave running. v0.8.59 through v0.8.83 shipped.

## Undo reaches every change, whoever made it

Every write to a project is now kept in a history you can undo or restore ([56c48a79b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/56c48a79beca307bbc05c2b0e70da47d933d6180), [#4431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4431)). `hyperframes preview` keeps that history, and Studio can tell its own edits apart from an agent's ([177464b4c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/177464b4c148a5091ccd745ca16d69d9bedd53f6), [#4437](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4437)). Undo and redo in Studio step through the whole history, including changes an agent or another tool made ([36f8bd0e9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36f8bd0e9112f4af7a09941b3f0f52864d5bd501), [#4456](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4456)). A host app can make Cmd+Z undo the newest change, whoever made it ([b165b64ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b165b64eda845f46f9b622b96e4545bf704d0950), [#4603](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4603)).

From the command line, `hyperframes history` lists, undoes and restores a project's recorded changes ([2734ee2c0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2734ee2c02ef858f3c877c18b56ebcfbb846cb4c), [#4449](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4449)). History can also copy the files from before or after any change into a folder ([7c017a08d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7c017a08de35e013beaee0f388afec7a6e4280bf), [#4493](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4493)). History saved by 0.8.78 survives the update with every entry ([3db3da7bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3db3da7bb284c5f0d89a1f7507d96115236e6bfc), [#4601](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4601)), and the history of a project that no longer exists is removed ([bee6a8e17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bee6a8e17d9198e734907b06e2c6f167529893e3), [#4634](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4634)).

## Studio as parts, not one app

Host apps can take more of Studio without the whole editor. DOM editing works outside EditorShell ([2251e5fad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2251e5fad01f841700098b91811c06f10d37f430), [#4640](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4640)). A host can reuse Studio's snapping and marquee selection in its own preview ([4aa6b168f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4aa6b168fea84a3a1a129e20d42974427b77615e), [#4635](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4635)), keep paint order in step with timeline rows ([93ab2899f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93ab2899f13a1120002986793a7b11b657841b69), [#4647](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4647)), and mount the timeline toolbar, undo buttons, meters and clipboard ([bc73c411f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc73c411f0bbf2b5e79c362ec78300ff5f08c520), [#4629](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4629)). It can draw the preview edge to edge ([326df8def](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/326df8def036e708d25a0ca0e069f91172767b0e), [#4408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4408)) and change what the shortcuts panel lists ([881481f56](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/881481f56b2682a62dc64b75a1237bc5e06a9bb7), [#4416](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4416)). The audio waveform and image thumbnail components are exported too ([b9fe13ad8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b9fe13ad8cfcbf1c8c0a95cf19cce7cf2918944d), [#4301](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4301)), and component styles ship as their own stylesheet ([d1048cf98](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1048cf98fc8ee8415f6ce02902ad51ae71cb09e), [#4393](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4393)).

A host's first screen can import Studio's UI and Player without pulling in the editor ([d2f0bc7f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2f0bc7f34837da54ae22063772d75d75ce26477), [#4650](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4650)). To find projects, `findProjects` lists the HyperFrames projects on a machine ([e738e1026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e738e1026793d144e95803a3a575fe448c07d90f), [#4627](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4627)), and the server lists the projects its history knows ([00ac4ef57](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00ac4ef571c6ccf7cd90cb65b23efaa7f74ea1f9), [#4639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4639)).

## A faster, lighter preview

A large film now opens ready to play in about 4 seconds instead of 32 ([f873734cc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f873734cc4d9fbc13914b9bd99915007ab47ae2a), [#4401](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4401)). The first frame shows sooner because preview assets load by URL ([86fa10ced](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86fa10ced4297bfd9f4fe67b6767afae7a07fd3c), [#4357](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4357)). The preview only loads and decodes images for scenes on screen or coming up next ([078c49344](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/078c493448cf73241bd9eb885a206ea1ccd951cc), [#4578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4578)). A file edit reaches the preview 30 ms after it lands, not 300 ([5c3f02c85](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c3f02c855f90be25699c39fd915223256c323cb), [#4348](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4348)), and the preview reloads only when a file it actually loaded changes ([e00baefb5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e00baefb5c536a10849bf94d0b8b2741aba60b37), [#4570](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4570)).

Playback does less work every frame. The whole app no longer re-renders each frame ([5a74db903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a74db903d316999e6210084cd30850ed08d16e4), [#4529](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4529)), the timecode and playhead no longer force a relayout ([471e90c05](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/471e90c057f799fbe7bdb1b03c53bef8e6a46d28), [#4593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4593)), and housekeeping runs on a timer instead of a frame count ([4ed269ad1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ed269ad1e3df0f948ded6320be08cb1058910db), [#4595](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4595)). A paused preview stops running its audio output ([36db44d9b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36db44d9b7a4a0e330b4605157ed76ffc0b9cd48), [#4534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4534)) and checks in once a second instead of every 80 ms ([0985b45c3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0985b45c32b18145224a8a460167dc18f23890cc), [#4512](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4512)). A clip's filmstrip decodes 9 frames instead of 272 ([db42e6022](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/db42e60223b0fdd075bb3c3433e84bd0615725fe), [#4526](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4526)), and an edit re-renders only that scene's thumbnails ([8cb7d06db](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8cb7d06db66faf567c425e972bb75057bc669322), [#4315](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4315)).

## Timeline and audio

The timeline has audio level meters at its right edge ([97420736d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97420736d56e6feef7396c8d100a33b2e913844a), [#4193](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4193)) with faders for groups and the master ([6f6d24248](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6f6d24248cb56c200fb6420e9000c63ecdeb1449), [#4203](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4203)). Audio pills show real peaks and loudness ([94609daf4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/94609daf445bb956888872af5faa8d6b635d40e2), [#4282](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4282)). You can type an audio value like "-6 dB" or "1.5x", add fades at a clip's edges, and a video you drop in keeps its sound ([839ae426d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/839ae426ddbcb3ad13ba21c586d87cde3aefa6f5), [#4250](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4250)). Video filmstrips are drawn to fit the clip ([5ca2e7838](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ca2e78383a1db3ed632a2eb5db9233db125afb3), [#4234](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4234)), and transition seams blur and carry a badge ([e5a037072](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5a03707272936777abbe3d08e4097fec4937fd2), [#4280](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4280)).

Editing got more exact. Dragging an audio clip's edge trims it instead of moving it ([074466729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0744667293e141e9ab3ed25d8a81ccc7ec2abbd7), [#4645](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4645)). A clip trimmed at the head stays in sync at any speed ([b3ab28aa4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b3ab28aa443eab102c2967061c7c70996a3651aa), [#4581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4581)), and carve and duck follow each clip's trim and speed ([7fae35f36](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7fae35f36efbdf396882e3829c10ff1c38ad2416), [#4661](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4661)). Trimming a scene no longer shrinks it to the length of a video inside it ([a3d7736d4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a3d7736d40ab5a4273fa1dda40d27a66bdad1bcf), [#4421](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4421)). Undo works right after pasting or duplicating clips ([caf704950](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/caf70495036883e9c479e7021f2bc31af86e4cab), [#4482](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4482)), and the timeline accepts m4v video and flac audio ([5eec51328](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5eec5132818c3f204d009a13c75e4dfd0abf401c), [#4649](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4649)).

## Renders match the preview

Colour now matches between the two. SDR renders keep footage and page colours as they are in the source ([c9b3d9c96](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9b3d9c9628d4c51696147ecd2fd881080e72824), [#4564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4564)). Forced-SDR renders tone-map HDR footage the way Studio shows it ([3a64ea867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a64ea867cc79949b51a482e24773e79bdff1d32), [#4600](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4600)), and Studio's HDR preview uses the render's tone map ([5257dd581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5257dd581f7c046982a4ec6e8874227e9dc62dbc), [#4606](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4606)).

Frames line up too. A render shows the same video frame the preview shows at each output frame ([e8313b2b3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8313b2b39674816a6057f4735f0f93df5b21fa1), [#4596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4596)), and export draws a video in exactly the frames it is shown in ([3def3514d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3def3514d1428b2dba7208c5e1d003cca7d0bfce), [#4565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4565)). A film stops at its declared length ([79144f914](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79144f914b88d79dd76cee084d40bd6fbf80feb9), [#4530](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4530)). Renders use the font named in a `var()` fallback ([04d56d06a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04d56d06aa2c9485c7c36e58fc74c224efdf7119), [#4619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4619)) and embed the exact Google font the page linked ([918e39e78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/918e39e78575ebf277b01546a017245ee2492bcc), [#4569](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4569)). Shader transitions in renders keep scene layout, styles and animations ([4094c7be4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4094c7be4c4f5aa63e1641fe028dbff4826513a4), [#4615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4615)), and GIF renders survive opaque frames among transparent ones ([5383e486b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5383e486bbc6781300ea3e6491affc4231ca337a), [#4610](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4610)).

## New effects and blocks

`data-vfx-chain` is a new per-pixel effect element that renders the same frame every time you seek to it ([b32b9a7da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b32b9a7dabf71e97049d1fa91a818817191414fc), [#4306](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4306)). It can capture what is behind it and run two-source kernels such as luma matte and noise ([84e36fc16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84e36fc16afcc9d5979f92b50b230bf0b8c29bb9), [#4330](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4330)). See the [VFX chain guide](/guides/vfx-chain).

The registry gained a Lottie character walk-in with looping Lottie that keeps playing ([805596174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/805596174007bff93dc1b5fe25c887e401f2d6d3), [#4316](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4316)), `text-match-cut` ([0945de83c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0945de83c7f51ba0c20c7c0a56421f066a378ee8), [#4288](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4288)), `extended-keyframe` ([b22bc2c97](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b22bc2c9791098dd02778c675e851f286d4048ed), [#4281](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4281)), `colorama-wipe` ([01734fae3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01734fae3c41b1f0c62779afece54133b1892f03), [#4277](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4277)), and a week-in-merges leaderboard ([d5e00c0e6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d5e00c0e66a8e3dadf6de40e197256195eb4c8dc), [#4264](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4264)). Examples now show the most-installed blocks ([53153d4a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53153d4a5470913586633738855a23caa8e0ca5f), [#4284](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4284)). Six blocks now load their own files and variables when mounted inside another composition ([53e2e20a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53e2e20a15fb183a773360543744793189557096), [#4452](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4452)).

## CLI, agents and lint

`hyperframes transcribe` can use Parakeet on macOS, Linux and Windows after an opt-in `hyperframes models install parakeet` ([5cbef29d3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5cbef29d3add1b40d08bcdf2c1ffcf758b8b7f5d), [#4583](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4583)). Portable agent bundles and installation guides ship as plugins ([0a5e3c7fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a5e3c7fc48229adc0db1aca1fe2d3c1d81b0415), [#4608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4608)). IBM Bob is a supported runtime ([105984cac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/105984cac4d8a52d99075cc06ed25ab2f12451e2), [#3930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3930)), agents get timeline workflows ([4e9059ad5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4e9059ad598add05f9b74346526e7ee3daddb1c4), [#4241](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4241)), and the media skills support Gemini TTS ([01601d110](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01601d110569967adbfe998e81f77bdeec4b1f2d), [#4377](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4377)). Brand logos resolve from theSVG ([d49e7b95e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d49e7b95e0b0a6577a42710ad2a7e0ca93280866), [#4291](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4291)).

New warnings catch layouts that look fine but render wrong. Lint warns on a negative z-index that hides an element behind the root ([42ae3da5b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/42ae3da5b6c54a6138ace2b983252d363df170d5), [#4403](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4403)), a canvas-level CSS zoom ([201c829c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/201c829c454dc55582cd0e01a7487228959d88d8), [#4412](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4412)), and a clip that ends past the root composition ([13bee7496](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13bee74960b089339d9606f9860e607f206b3fa2), [#4633](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4633)). The CLI warns when content touches the frame edge ([7556b95ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7556b95ac6ab7ab43e0c6973dd7673bb839434a9), [#4427](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4427)). Findings point at the exact source line and column ([d27435c07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d27435c070ed2853b8336af9d738aca238e071e6), [#4353](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4353)).

The CLI is also steadier. Commands exit right away even when the network is broken ([693c38550](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/693c38550888f6aa4277d4e4fb4bac8c77177316), [#4604](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4604)). An update never replaces the CLI's files while a command is running ([f39b17903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f39b179030f898266714d2b1732e1800fe7ce8de), [#4637](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4637)). Stopping the preview server no longer leaves Chrome running ([1b8f8a43d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1b8f8a43d43bc2456075215b066b23e11d821435), [#4183](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4183)).

## Files stay where they belong

The static server keeps every request inside the folder it serves ([cc19b8c81](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cc19b8c8121d938aa589c50363f3c099e8dec8e7), [#4217](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4217)). A write through a link lands on the file the system resolves ([59e3850f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59e3850f6a54f4d853b6cbc9af11032c05dbe2b6), [#4589](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4589)), and background removal writes only where it checked ([03e3755aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03e3755aaacff101e8b760329d3dc0622341d34a), [#4540](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4540)). A project path typed in a different letter case stays inside the project ([259f65c00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/259f65c000b43e6deba6ba89f925dc8cc0fe6e93), [#4514](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4514)), and skill scripts can only import from inside their installed folders ([29fc95395](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29fc95395debf2e8809f27b2a9943ccc973235d0), [#4356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4356)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

**Week of September 14, 2026**

Weekly digest - September 14, 2026 - September 21, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep14 21" />

Studio became something you can build on this week. Speed ramps landed end to end, and long renders got a new capture route.

## Studio is now a library, not just an app

Host apps can take the parts of Studio they need instead of embedding the whole editor. The timeline is composable ([064192155](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0641921558eadcee0a026fa6db39e3e9e5b76f62), [#4229](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4229)), the player exposes a handle ([4ff4435e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ff4435e1d46f16ae1f10a19109cd7824b9ae775), [#4227](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4227)), and timeline editing works outside EditorShell ([5262062e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5262062e7be20b26a7c1a4ce4be2ec3831f151d6), [#4201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4201)). A host can place overlays on the preview and restyle its stage ([ef6432317](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ef64323174c94b58550cb32e59a6819daf1a5e41), [#4187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4187)), import the render queue ([fd020ca27](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fd020ca27cfd6a3a78524e22d69339a3dcdf1740), [#4184](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4184)), open the ask-agent flow from a picked element ([e174b1715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e174b1715b6ef0897693a0d278c72343d11f2a1d), [#4075](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4075)), or make the preview read-only ([84e653166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84e65316683c5636e83720d7d4a8cd612275df9d), [#4200](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4200)). The header logo, button sizes and a stable `styles.css` subpath are exported too ([2d84937e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2d84937e1f28ee60dd7dc23bdedfd324793e10d0), [#4197](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4197)).

## Speed ramps, all the way through

You can author a speed ramp as a rate lane in `data-automation` ([7f452ad27](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f452ad27656f14e58403069190c1856b1a91a0b), [#4129](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4129)), edit it in Studio with a lane and presets ([0c158be16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c158be165068cbbce55d0613750e7474d3c486a), [#4153](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4153)), and render it with the same source-time mapping the preview uses ([bdecae066](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bdecae066a1a9a1f270b29378975b5a1830de4b0), [#4143](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4143)). The render matches what you saw. No flag to turn any of it on.

## Timeline editing

Copy, paste and duplicate clip groups ([0b6d1039e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b6d1039ed0a799fd088fd7af8a4b9440208e23a), [#4064](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4064)). The main track is magnetic and closes gaps when you delete ([8fe480c0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8fe480c0a0a4796ebc4b12f05f45ac1329707bb9), [#4069](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4069)). Undo and redo moved into the timeline toolbar ([f9fc55218](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9fc55218880ff62bb580d8a2340cfe4bf323282), [#4196](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4196)). Trimming shows the snap guide and the frame at the edge you are dragging ([86667203c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86667203ce14adc398326fe75bd5af81a1dd6436), [#4163](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4163)). The timeline shows one row per top-level element ([7797c5ead](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7797c5ead4c0ecd41745b3be9b8f5a266762e603), [#4132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4132)), and the preview gained ruler and safe-margin toggles ([898d27869](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/898d27869ea16aeb6e58d7f6fe0ef1267ccbfe30), [#4127](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4127)).

The CLI caught up. `hyperframes timeline` prints a project's tracks and clips ([0a5c23517](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a5c235173ddcc1118e68eb6d84d0b01b6895aa6), [#4138](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4138)), reports real media durations ([7597b80c9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7597b80c950f22ab61dcc5fec4bb59e37f05fe64), [#4169](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4169)), lists nested clips in one flat list ([ac0d8ced2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac0d8ced2a19f2ef9700e57f5b2d2297992cb9e9), [#4173](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4173)), and now has editing verbs ([f92d017b9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f92d017b999d26b14c49a8439dc16d2e476bffde), [#4221](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4221)).

## One design system, and a layout you can move

Studio moved onto shared primitives: buttons, icon buttons, tooltips and tabs ([01aa446ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01aa446edf6a4282a6ac1fc080a002478f91434b), [#3622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3622)), then menus, popovers and value controls ([3ec26b5e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ec26b5e27d0e935c8c30ecceed73ee4ef2599d4), [#4191](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4191)). Every design value lives in one theme file ([339dc7602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/339dc76026b90828d29700ff13edcb3e364852c3), [#3621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3621)), timeline colours read from CSS tokens ([9bd6da848](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9bd6da848fb39513ed4e21911c574315aab477e5), [#4211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4211)), and Studio is on Tailwind CSS v4 ([68b61675e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/68b61675ed4debabe1cbd453b9b926cf76451b5f), [#3618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3618)). A test now fails the suite on a class that resolves to nothing ([93ff9a994](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93ff9a994d5f6f7770035a80bf3609d09f15f8c0), [#3623](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3623)).

Panels sit on a dockable, persisted layout ([98e8372a0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98e8372a0aaaefd498a558db96ed2d2feac3a275), [#4192](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4192)) built on a new dock engine ([dc9469244](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc94692441d6aaf4ed56531ba1f88ac4c48b76b0), [#4165](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4165)). Dividers and tabs work from the keyboard, and side columns fit narrow windows ([e505dcc5c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e505dcc5c5b507c45b5010baa31b836b934dab29), [#4186](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4186)). UI preferences scope per project ([a192701ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a192701adb118e510d6c4f284108e99f2e37ed85), [#4093](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4093)).

## Motion blur

Capture accumulates sub-frame samples ([0a1c6f5a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a1c6f5a457ca1345d6b8ccede04769a0e009719), [#4019](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4019)) with an adaptive per-frame sample count ([2ab7b8686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ab7b8686870cb435674e20d48b4100db2fa2052), [#4031](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4031)), and it is reachable from a render ([b64a7a3a6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b64a7a3a67ae1f5c22915a88938853169eb3cea2), [#4020](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4020)). Registry blur now matches After Effects shutter-based blur ([9aa60a844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9aa60a844fa645ef92949cf6025ddbb634a97e63), [#4008](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4008)), and you mark an element to blur it instead of calling a function ([752b55278](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/752b55278986089636aaf3b2eb113d1da2f037d7), [#4045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4045)). A capture route that cannot blur fails loudly instead of quietly shipping sharp frames ([77a45f608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/77a45f6080daedd12ab67a3d1c9d165b8ae003b3), [#4026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4026)).

## Long renders

There is a new segmented capture route for long-form work. It plans segments, writes a manifest keyed by a content-addressed plan hash, skips segments it already validated on resume, and recycles the browser between segments. It is **opt-in behind `HF_SEGMENTED_CAPTURE`** and is not the default yet. The flip to routing long renders through it automatically is a separate release step, gated on a 40-minute soak.

Reliability work landed alongside it. Disk capture stops early when the frames cannot fit ([35a4fe1da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35a4fe1da7e6564693fbc96996eeaa96836a2ca5), [#4164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4164)), a dead browser tab retries once ([73f39862f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73f39862f2019a13d9a36f635c808e5cba7fc57e), [#4162](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4162)), and a CDP screenshot refusal retries instead of failing the render ([a0a6244be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a0a6244be7a40956c5343f5846609e584ee5c6b5), [#3892](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3892)). Render events now carry Chrome memory and the capture path they took.

## Playback and output

Playback waits for real readiness instead of guessing. Play gates on composition readiness ([72b223d57](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72b223d57f5bf21c91ba77c244254672bf9c6023), [#4054](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4054)), cross-origin compositions wait for their assets ([a7282dcd0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7282dcd0eb888ab496dcbd41a1e35ac2a3bb1c7), [#4103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4103)), and the interactive clock absorbs a main-thread stall instead of skipping past it ([2de3ca5f8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2de3ca5f86da3b8bb2fdc3e62dd181c4ca565f55), [#4053](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4053)). A finished film rests on its last frame ([f4e00ce2b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f4e00ce2b52591bd901d937debb1922b321cb0d7), [#4158](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4158)), and a WebGPU composition never renders silently blank ([9981d9afb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9981d9afb74e1280bf7136cd0043d895cb570b24), [#4091](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4091)).

A composition with no authored length now takes it from its clips ([fa44d7621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa44d7621d3aa664761731322a6cda62b1444b58), [#4174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4174)), with video, audio and image length coming from one shared resolver ([09aadd86a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09aadd86a5b87805bb4917604199e4367627d8d7), [#4166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4166)). HLS is available as an output format from both the producer ([462f9db73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/462f9db73dc0951a112a057416d03effb2fcf1a0), [#4014](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4014)) and the CLI ([e4b1832fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e4b1832fadd4c063bcf9a19cd351684815fbc23e), [#4022](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4022)).

## CLI

macOS 12 users get Chrome 150 automatically and can render again ([0cde88433](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0cde88433071eb0572ebe84f3b5c1680f54f537c), [#4185](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4185)). Capture runs are bounded and WebGL navigation degrades instead of hanging ([952e9228b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/952e9228b5cdf4387ecb4b6f220ef8e5d9143a73), [#4215](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4215)). A failed Docker render names the container's last error ([45f92e557](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45f92e55725364003718b7e3c36e05179dcbf43a), [#4168](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4168)), and a missing or stale Studio build is caught before it crashes ([de9206e0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/de9206e0f8512ea6fca539c981c1688db6771045), [#4076](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4076)).

**Week of September 7, 2026**

Weekly digest - September 7, 2026 - September 14, 2026

<video aria-label="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep07 14" />

Studio spent the week getting faster and quieter. A paused editor now costs almost nothing, and scrubbing a long composition no longer stalls. The rest of the week went into trust. Messages between a preview and the page that hosts it are now authenticated, and anything HyperFrames downloads is checked before it is used. v0.8.32 through v0.8.40 shipped.

## Studio stops working when you stop

* A paused editor no longer redraws its overlays sixty times a second ([9549e038c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9549e038c43a72305275e0e1732fb0d7723bf84c), [#3846](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3846)).
* A paused preview stops burning CPU ([d4fba55a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4fba55a4ee632f74484c6c7498a132b9928ce03), [#3845](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3845)).
* Scrubbing a large composition no longer stalls the editor ([0408fbcd9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0408fbcd9989331a88a0b647368a33957cbbb257), [#3842](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3842)).
* Studio rebuilds and seeks are now sublinear in the size of the composition ([8bf5b4423](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8bf5b4423e704ea4578b9fd5dd988907fbfc45bf), [#3837](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3837)).
* The editor stops waking during a drag on a preview it did not build ([c752b89bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c752b89bc9de5418bb34c5c7efa71fac0b69cc48), [#3850](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3850)).
* A selector's occurrence index resolves once per layer walk instead of once per element ([ac27b1534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac27b1534f45ae6d8250842613a769ec220c9c47), [#3831](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3831)).
* One timing resolver serves a whole pass, and duration is derived only when the composition changes ([3ea2f909e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ea2f909e15ed11a556812788e328f2dd4893c42), [#3824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3824)).

## Messages between frames name their sender

* Studio preview messages are authenticated ([4f77c282d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4f77c282dafe044ab773d8ecb5c96f6fa8b5ebf6), [#3812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3812)).
* Runtime control messages are authenticated ([b8328f957](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b8328f957368713d288900957eb5bee0dca31dd9), [#3813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3813)).
* Slideshow navigation senders are authenticated ([8d80530ff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d80530ff4507a87a8689aa3f48e6062859540d2), [#3820](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3820)).
* Deck sound effect messages are authenticated ([c6010f2eb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6010f2eb82ff3f0331f4d65c333fba800623857), [#3819](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3819)).
* Runtime and playground message dispatch is restricted to what each page actually handles ([05d726105](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/05d7261052f9d2585af0538967849383dc391119), [#3816](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3816)).

## Downloads are checked before they are used

* Every download redirect target is validated ([a7e2e3853](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7e2e3853a347c862d0d910515c7224a14b114f0), [#3841](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3841)).
* Capture and render share one host policy, and localhost aliases are blocked ([96637aeb1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/96637aeb1c38a0d9fec0522b0ba1bbb84aa6b301), [#3844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3844)).
* Hosted preview asset downloads are confined ([cd1a996ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd1a996ba4d31136b237b4f3c178f91982a27488), [#3843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3843)).
* Captured images and fonts are validated ([1aa5b9e4f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1aa5b9e4fac929ca1cf097e3a99c075fada7a37f), [#3809](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3809)).
* Captured Lottie archives and previews are validated ([26916b7bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26916b7bddbcc2ef782a59bd31c79801ff5258b4), [#3811](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3811)).

## New defaults in the CLI

* Looks is now the default render quality at CRF 16, and delivery is high ([f059a6eb5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f059a6eb539e6289d20156f04eb04a43ddc8b806), [#3927](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3927)).
* A local auto render requests BeginFrame unless PRODUCER\_FORCE\_SCREENSHOT says otherwise, and the render summary names the capture path, the GPU mode and the stage timings.
* A bare init scaffolds a centered blank stage with no prompts.
* The gsap\_exit\_missing\_hard\_kill lint rule is gone. Its hazard did not reproduce on cold workers.
